**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




  





 At Legend World Rent A Car, we've built something worth being proud of — a fast\-growing rent\-a\-car operation with big ambitions.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 Now we're looking for the person who helps us scale it right. This isn't just a title. It's a seat at the table. We need a sharp, ownership\-driven leader who can bring structure to fast\-moving operations, grow revenue, and build processes that actually stick.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Operational Excellence — Drive end\-to\-end operational performance across all departments, ensuring consistent delivery and efficiency.
* Revenue \& Margin Growth — Lead pricing strategy, revenue growth initiatives, and margin improvement programs.
* Process Optimization — Identify and eliminate waste; automate manual workflows and build scalable systems.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership — Align and execute across operations, sales, finance, and technology teams.
* Data \& Reporting — Build and maintain management reporting frameworks, KPIs, and actionable dashboards.
* Business Development — Identify and develop new revenue streams and business model opportunities.



  









**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* Experience: 4–8 years in operations, program management, or general management.
* Track Record: Proven results: revenue up, costs down, teams aligned.
* Commercial Mindset: You think in margins, not just tasks — always anchored to business outcomes.
* Ownership: A proactive problem\-solver who moves fast, takes initiative, and follows through.
* Location: Based in the UAE. Any industry background is welcome.



  









**PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE** 




  




* Fast\-growing operation with real ambition and room to shape the direction.
* A role where your impact is visible every single day.
* Autonomy to build, fix, and scale — not just manage status quo.
* Collaborative leadership that values results over hierarchy.



  









**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT** 




  





 Ready to build something great? If you've built something, fixed something, or scaled something — and you're ready for a role where your impact is visible every day — we want to hear from you. Send a DM, drop a comment, or tag someone who would thrive here.

**Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the Amazon Marketplace Experience Transformation (AMET) function for Delivery Associates (DAs) and Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey. In this critical role, you will be focusing on local operations while developing and executing the regional strategy. You will leverage multiple listening channels to identify experience priorities, consolidate feedback, and work cross\-functionally to address key improvement opportunities. This position requires exceptional stakeholder management and strategic thinking to create meaningful programs that enhance the overall driver and DSP experience across diverse markets.
   

  

 Your expertise in program management, strategy development, and influence without authority will be essential as you partner with external entities to create impactful campaigns, present strategies to senior leadership, and drive initiatives that transform the delivery partner experience. You will serve as the strategic voice for delivery partners, ensuring their needs are represented in business decisions while balancing operational excellence and partner satisfaction
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for delivery partner experience across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey, while maintaining focused implementation in Saudi Arabian operations.
* Collect and analyze insights from multiple listening channels to identify experience priorities, then work cross\-functionally with operations teams, ACES, and DEX teams to address structural challenges within established SLAs.
* Draft comprehensive strategy documents and present recommendations to senior leadership, driving alignment and securing resources for key initiatives.
* Establish and manage partnerships with external entities to create campaigns and benefits for Delivery Associates and DSPs, including organizing annual partner meetings and launching ignite events throughout the region.
* Lead country expansion efforts and new program launches within AMET, ensuring consistent implementation of best practices while adapting to local market needs.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 5\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in Arabic\-language communication skills, both written and verbal


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You will need for this position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**
* Exceptional written communication; produces board\-quality documents, strategic memos, and executive briefings independently
* Ability to process complexity quickly, communicate it clearly, and operate with minimal direction
* Genuinely AI\-native; uses AI to increase personal and team velocity, with experience managing AI\-enabled workflows or operating system design
* Sufficient fluency across technology, capital markets, and business transformation to engage credibly across Moove’s active workstreams
* Strong product and technology instincts; understands how software is built, how platforms scale, and how technology and physical operations intersect
* Sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate
* Available across geographies and time zones as required


**What Does Success Look Like**
* The Co\-CEO and President’s office operates as a high\-performance execution engine, no decisions stall, no commitments drop
* The company’s operating cadence is designed, implemented, and running effectively within the first 90 days
* OKRs and performance scorecards are embedded and generating actionable insights for the executive team
* Governance structures and decision rights are documented and operational across all business units
* Board and investor outputs are produced on time, to a consistently high standard
* Strategic workstreams move faster and with greater clarity as a direct result of this role’s involvement


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CO\-CEO \& President, and closely working with our office of the CEO team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

data.jd_text:
**Your mission**
 The Project Director is responsible for driving the successful delivery of projects while actively contributing to the creation and execution of the business plan for future projects.
   

  

 This role goes beyond project leadership \- it’s about strategically shaping our global presence with a primary focus on the Middle East, ensuring operational excellence, and contributing directly to the long\-term growth targets of the Event Production unit.
   

  

 Working closely with the Director of Event Production BU and the wider leadership team, the Project Director will translate the business plans into actionable initiatives, ensure targets are met, maintain and expand client relationships, and strengthen our competitive position in the market.
   

  

 The role also requires close collaboration with other Project Directors across the organisation to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and collective progress toward shared goals.
   

  

 This position reflects our new structure of appointing Project Directors with defined focus areas (e.g., KSA, UAE, Special Projects Global), ensuring scalability and dedicated leadership as our business continues to expand.
   

  

**Leadership \& Strategic Oversight**
* Provide vision, direction, and leadership for project management team.
* Align with the Director of Event Production to deliver on the agreed business plan, targets, and growth strategy.
* Establish clear objectives, OKRs, and performance standards for the Event Production project portfolio.
* Coordinate and collaborate with other Project Directors to ensure alignment of strategies, processes, and delivery standards across all focus areas.
* Drive efficiency, best practices, and continuous improvement in project delivery.
* Mentor, motivate, and support project managers, building a scalable structure that fosters accountability and innovation.


**Project Execution \& Delivery**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects, ensuring quality, timeliness, and profitability.
* Serve as the senior client\-facing representative, ensuring trust and satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
* Define and oversee project structures, including scheduling, budgeting, risk assessment, and resource allocation.
* Ensure disciplined financial and operational management across projects.
* Guarantee compliance with health, safety, and quality standards in close collaboration with QHSE.


**Standardisation \& Best Practices**
* Implement and refine standardised workflows for projects while aligning with global unit standards.
* Apply project management methodologies, documentation, and approval processes that reduce risk and increase efficiency.
* Contribute to structured knowledge\-sharing between all focus areas (KSA, UAE, Special Projects, etc.)


****Client Liaison \& Stakeholder Management****
* Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with existing clients.
* Work closely with the Business Development to identify, approach, and secure new client relationships.
* Act as a senior representative to clients, ensuring clarity of scope, expectations, and outcomes.
* Capture client feedback and integrate it into project delivery and future business planning.
* Nurture partnerships with subcontractors, suppliers, and freelancers to ensure reliable and high\-quality delivery.


****Financial \& Commercial Oversight****
* Manage budgets, forecasts, and margin protection across projects.
* Support the Director of Event Production in financial disciplines, risk management, and profitability strategies.
* Drive commercial success by balancing operational efficiency with exceptional client delivery.


****Innovation \& Continuous Improvement****
* Stay ahead of regional market trends, event production innovations, and project management best practices.
* Translate lessons learned into better processes and future planning for upcoming projects.
* Collaborate across units, regions, and with other Project Directors to ensure creative, technical, and operational excellence.


**Your profile**
* Demonstrated extensive project management experience in turnkey project delivery, including hands\-on experience with AVL and fit\-out installations in the field of events of various complexity and scales.
* Good understanding of technical, business and contractual correlations in all complexity.
* Proven ability to manage large budgets.
* Strong industry network in the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* English language proficiency is a must.
* Flexible to work based on the requirements of the live event industry.


**Why us?**
* Unified CAT A Silver Premium Medical Insurance provided as standard to all team members – yes, you read that correctly, we all enjoy the same insurance category benefits!
* Complimentary lunches provided daily in our Dubai office canteen.
* Team Engagement Initiatives – team\-building activities, health and wellness drives, etc.
* Team Socials – team BBQs, season opening and closing parties.
* Worker’s Compensation and Accident Insurance.
* Annual flight allowance.
* Recruitment Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful applicants for our open positions.
* Project Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful project leads.
* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!

data.jd_text:
**Delivery Lead – AI\-Native Platforms \& Operations** 




 Reports directly to the CTO – Small, growing team – Cross\-functional ownership
 



  





**About the role**




 We are building a portfolio of AI\-native platforms, internal operational systems, enterprise technology services, and venture\-stage digital products. We are a small, growing team that uses modern AI tools as a force multiplier across product, engineering, operations, and support.
 



 We are looking for a highly capable generalist who can operate as the CTO's second\-in\-command across multiple business units and technical teams including delivery, technology operations, product execution, and organisational enablement.
 



 You will help turn strategy into execution. One day you may be helping improve support operations through AI agents, the next you may be preparing a platform for production launch, coordinating infrastructure readiness, reviewing a product roadmap, or helping shape a new venture.
 



 This role offers significant visibility, influence, and responsibility, with ownership over delivery outcomes rather than simply managing tasks.
 



  





**What you’ll own**




 You will help drive successful execution across three primary areas:
 



  





**Technology Operations \& IT** 




 ·      Support the evolution of IT operations into an AI\-enabled support model
 



 ·      Improve service management, operational processes, and support capabilities
 



 ·      Coordinate infrastructure, security, access management, and operational readiness activities
 



 ·      Help standardise tools, platforms, and ways of working across the organisation
 



 ·      Ensure technology teams have the foundations required to scale effectively
 



**Product Delivery \& Platform Enablement** 




 ·      Work alongside Product Owners and Platform Owners to convert ideas into deliverable outcomes
 



 ·      Coordinate platform launches, releases, testing, and go\-live activities
 



 ·      Support production readiness including:
 



 ·      Authentication and identity management
 



 ·      App Store and Google Play publication
 



 ·      Infrastructure readiness
 



 ·      Monitoring and support processes
 



 ·      Documentation and operational handover
 



 ·      Identify delivery risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and mitigation plans
 



**Venture \& Platform Development** 




 ·      Support the creation and growth of new digital ventures and internal platforms
 



 ·      Work directly with stakeholders to define requirements and shape solutions
 



 ·      Take ownership of smaller products and initiatives where appropriate
 



 ·      Use AI tools to accelerate prototyping, delivery, testing, and operational improvements
 



 ·      Help transform concepts into working products that deliver measurable business value
 



  





**What you’ll do**




 ·      Act as the operational right\-hand person to the CTO across technology, product, and delivery activities
 



 ·      Coordinate initiatives across product, engineering, support, infrastructure, vendors, and business stakeholders
 



 ·      Translate strategic objectives into executable plans
 



 ·      Own delivery governance across multiple concurrent projects and workstreams
 



 ·      Track dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and delivery milestones
 



 ·      Help define and improve delivery frameworks, standards, and ways of working
 



 ·      Facilitate workshops, planning sessions, reviews, and stakeholder updates
 



 ·      Support product discovery, requirements gathering, and roadmap development
 



 ·      Review user journeys and operational workflows to identify improvement opportunities
 



 ·      Use AI tools to automate delivery activities, documentation, reporting, testing, and operational processes
 



 ·      Assist in vendor management, procurement, and technology evaluations where required
 



 ·      Build reporting, dashboards, and management visibility across technology initiatives
 



 ·      Ensure products are operationally ready before launch
 



 ·      Drive accountability and momentum across teams while maintaining a pragmatic, outcome\-focused approach
 



  





**What we’re looking for**




 ·      Strong experience and exposure across delivery, programme management, product management, technology operations, cyber security infrastructure and business systems leadership
 



 ·      Proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and drive complex initiatives to completion
 



 ·      Comfortable operating across product, engineering, operations, and support functions
 



 ·      Strong organisational skills without becoming process\-heavy or bureaucratic
 



 ·      Commercially minded and focused on business outcomes rather than activity metrics
 



 ·      Hands\-on experience using AI tools to improve productivity and accelerate delivery
 



 ·      Strong problem\-solving ability with a bias toward action
 



 ·      Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping create structure where it does not yet exist
 



 ·      Able to balance strategic thinking with practical execution
 



 ·      Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 



 ·      Able to challenge constructively while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships
 



 ·      Comfortable switching between executive conversations and detailed operational discussions
 



  





**The practical test for this role**




 This role requires someone who can coordinate, prioritise, and execute across multiple disciplines simultaneously.
 



 As part of the interview process, candidates will be given a realistic business scenario involving a combination of product delivery, operational challenges, stakeholder management, and technology implementation.
 



 We are not testing whether someone can produce perfect documentation or create the most detailed project plan. We are testing their ability to:
 



 ·      Understand a complex situation quickly
 



 ·      Prioritise effectively
 



 ·      Identify risks and dependencies
 



 ·      Use AI tools to accelerate execution
 



 ·      Create pragmatic delivery plans
 



 ·      Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
 



 If you require highly structured environments, extensive support, or detailed instructions to operate effectively, this is unlikely to be the right role.
 



 If you enjoy solving problems, creating momentum, and taking ownership across multiple domains, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Bonus experience**




 The following is helpful but not required if the core fit is strong:
 



 ·      Product Management experience
 



 ·      IT Service Management (ITIL or equivalent)
 



 ·      AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude, Codex, Replit, Copilot, or ChatGPT
 



 ·      Workflow automation platforms including n8n, Zapier, or Make
 



 ·      Azure, AWS, or cloud infrastructure platforms
 



 ·      Authentication platforms and identity management
 



 ·      SaaS platform implementation and administration
 



 ·      Vendor and third\-party supplier management
 



 ·      Agile delivery methodologies
 



 ·      SQL, APIs, integrations, and automation
 



 ·      SAP/Salesforce/ODOO experience

data.jd_text:
**Project Manager – ONESOURCE**
**Thomson Reuters** 
 is a leading provider of transaction tax management solutions to companies of all sizes, enabling Finance, Tax and IT professionals to achieve accurate, timely and cost\-effective compliance. Our flagship offering, the Thomson Reuters Application Suite, provides Consolidated Transaction Tax Management software and services, enabling global enterprise to manage sales, use, value\-add, excise and specialty taxes with consistency, accuracy, control and efficiency. The marketplace is demanding our products, and Thomson Reuters is poised to grow significantly over the next several years in geographies across the world.
   

  

 We are now hiring an
 **ONESOURCE Technology Implementation \& Consulting Project Manager** 
 to lead the delivery of software implementation projects within the Indirect Tax consulting organization. You will work closely with project teams, peer project managers, sales, customer service, clients, and partner consulting teams.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **ONESOURCE Project Manager,** 
 you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Service Delivery \& Portfolio Management
* Manage an assigned portfolio of Thomson Reuters implementation projects.
* Direct project teams and own end\-to\-end delivery.
* Ensure strong planning, quality control, client management, and customer satisfaction.
* End\-to\-End Project Management
* Lead project planning sessions to define scope, approach, and delivery plans.
* Manage multiple complex projects/issues simultaneously, often requiring subject matter expertise.
* Drive operational improvements, efficiency, and results.
* Meet revenue and utilization targets as defined by management.
* Communication \& Status Reporting
* Maintain clear communication with clients and internal teams.
* Prepare and deliver regular project status updates.
* Share knowledge and updates across the broader organization.
* Delivery Leadership
* Provide guidance and leadership to team members (and/or manage a team).
* Make routine decisions within established guidelines, including approved exceptions.
* Manage or contribute to project cost control, forecasting, and budget recommendations.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of deliverables; maintain accountability across the team.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support broader organizational goals.
* Consulting \& Subject Matter Expertise
* Deliver consulting services to external clients in tax technology, legal, and global trade domain as part of Thomson Reuters Professional service team.
* Provide subject matter expertise to support customer deliverables.
* Travel
* 40–45% travel is required.


**About You**
 To be our
 **ONESOURCE Project Manager** 
 , you will likely have:
   

  

* 12\+ years of core project management experience (with project management certification e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).
* 15\+ years total experience in ERP, tax, or technology domains.
* Experience delivering consulting and technology implementation projects with diverse teams and large customers, including MENA and global clients.
* Proven ability to manage multiple parallel projects end\-to\-end.
* Strong understanding of:
+ O2C (Order\-to\-Cash) and/or P2P (Procure\-to\-Pay)
+ Indirect tax, e\-invoicing, or related tax technology processes

data.jd_text:
VEON is a Nasdaq\-listed global digital operator that serves more than 150 million customers with connectivity and about 120 million monthly active users with digital services in some of the world’s most exciting frontier markets. Operating across 5 countries that are home to nearly 520 million people, in other words more than 6% of the world’s population, VEON transforms lives through technology\-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth.
   

  

 With VEON’s Digital Operator 1440 vision and strategy, VEON Group companies redefine the engagement that telecom operators have with their customers, providing the best digital experience to customers up to 1440 minutes in a day. We transform not only the daily experience of the final users, but also support the growth of enterprises and industries as a whole, using cutting\-edge technologies in AI, big\-data and cloud services to serve our business customers.
   

  

 This is all underpinned by a commitment to sustainability, ensuring VEON’s operations are run safely and ethically while fostering digital entrepreneurship and greater digital skills and literacy in the communities in which VEON operates. VEON’s values\-based approach works to strengthen trust by building a responsible and sustainable business that benefits customers, employees, communities, and shareholders.
   

  

 VEON’s international leadership team is drawn from experienced executives from around the world and has been led by CEO Kaan Terzioğlu since July 2021\.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Manager, Strategic Planning supports the CEO Office and Chief of Staff in driving strategic alignment across the Group, between HQ and Operating Companies (OpCos), and in interactions with the Board and Board Office.
   

  

 The role is the central owner of the quality, consistency, and coherence of content produced by the CEO Office. It requires the ability to absorb large volumes of information from multiple functions, synthesize diverse perspectives into clear executive narratives, and ensure that all outputs accurately reflect Group priorities. Whether preparing Board materials, drafting CEO and Chairman letters, or shaping the content agenda for leadership events, the individual ensures that information is well\-structured, aligned, and ready for executive audiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Coordinate the development of CEO and Board presentation materials by gathering inputs from HQ functions and OpCos, reviewing content for accuracy, consistency and strategic alignment, consolidating key messages, and assembling executive\-ready presentation decks. The role does not independently create Board content, but serves as the central integrator responsible for the quality and coherence of the final output.
* Partner closely with the Performance Analytics team to combine quantitative performance data with qualitative business updates, creating clear and compelling narratives that reflect Group priorities and strategic progress.
* Draft CEO and Chairman letters, ensuring messaging is concise, consistent, and aligned with the Group's strategic direction.
* Coordinate Leadership Team meetings, including virtual meetings every three weeks and quarterly in\-person sessions, by developing agendas, coordinating content, tracking decisions and follow\-up actions, and ensuring alignment across HQ and OpCos.
* Work alongside the Performance Analytics and Communications teams to shape the strategic content and execution of Ignite, the Group's annual Top 200 leadership event, ensuring alignment around business priorities while supporting engagement, collaboration, and recognition.
* Support the CEO Office in preparing for OpCo Board and Committee meetings by coordinating materials, managing inputs, and assisting the CEO in his role as Chair of the OpCo Boards.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives and ad hoc projects that strengthen alignment, governance, and collaboration across the Group.


**Critical Skills \& Experience**
* Outstanding ability to absorb large volumes of information, identify what matters, and rapidly synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative inputs into concise, executive\-level deliverables.
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with experience preparing high\-quality materials for CEOs, Chairmen, Boards, or Executive Leadership Teams.
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to challenge data, connect business insights, and develop clear strategic narratives.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively across diverse HQ functions and international OpCos while balancing differing priorities and maintaining a coherent storyline.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams in a fast\-paced executive environment.
* Comfortable working with senior executives and exercising sound judgment regarding when to take initiative and when to escalate decisions.
* Experience supporting executive meetings, workshops, Board meetings, or leadership events from both a content coordination and execution perspective.
* Native or near\-native proficiency in spoken and written English.
* Willingness to relocate to Dubai is preferred.
* Ability to travel internationally approximately five to six times per year.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Approximately 5–7 years of relevant professional experience in a CEO Office, Chief of Staff Office, Strategy, Executive Office, PMO, Management Consulting, or similar environment supporting senior leadership.

**We Put Results Above Rituals**
* We focus on action over theory, purpose and clarity over bureaucracy and rituals.

**We Hire for Potential and Drive**

**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 Have a central role in designing and implementing the Fulfillment \& Logistics capabilities whilst aligning with the leadership of Operations vertical and other business partners on what matters most. Lead the business case creation and capability development prioritization with a three\-year horizon in close collaboration with the Head of Capability Development and Chief Logistics and Fulfillment Officer. Maintain an understanding of advancements in process, technology and other innovations which are happening across the supply chain \& logistics ecosystem within the retail industry.
   

  

 In their endeavor to excellence, the fundamental values all our employees must possess are Commitment, Integrity, Empathy and Flexibility
   

  

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Design and deliver the logistics \& fulfillment capabilities simultaneously driving insights into actions by evaluating and understanding operational and business needs.
* Develop detailed business cases to initiatives and lead prioritisation of capabilities utilising business case information to trade\-off decisions.
* Navigate and influence complex organizational structures and align the cross\-cultural, cross\-functional teams including leadership in the capability roadmap prioritization.
* Implement the prioritised capabilities across the end\-to\-end fulfillment and logistics processes assisting the local teams.
* Apply programme management principles and tools to ensure capabilities are delivered at speed, adopted and sustained within the group.
* Build and manage highly effective teams to help design and implement capabilities, with a strong focus in developing the junior colleagues.
* Be a servant leader and great teammate able to navigate a matrix work environment and excel as a self\-directed influencer and leader.
* Be highly analytical and data driven to make informed decisions.
* Balance multiple deadlines and priorities along with communication to the related stakeholders.
* Identify leading, innovative and practical ideas \& solutions fit for purpose for Chalhoub's logistics and fulfillment capabilities.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.jd_text:
**About noon** 




 noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform. Since its launch on December 12th, 2017, in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and its expansion into Egypt in February 2019, noon has grown into a diverse ecosystem spanning marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. noon is a work in progress \- six years in, but only 5% done.
 



  





**noon’s mission:** 
 Ring every doorbell, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.



  





 Is this you?

data.jd_text:
Job Purpose:
 



 Oversee the planning, execution, and control of Rail Design’s Gold Line Metro portfolio, ensuring
 



 alignment with Dubai and RTA strategies, the Rail Network Plan 2032, and the corporate governance framework. Ensure the project is executed with high quality from start to finish. Provide strategic advice, monitor performance, and coordinate with partners to maintain compliant, efficient, and results\-driven delivery. Ensure program management components align with RTA’s strategic objectives, governance frameworks, quality standards, approved budgets, and operational excellence standards.
 



  





 Roles \& Accountabilities:
 



  





 Strategy
 



 • Serve as the primary advisor to RTA management and CEOs on Gold Line Metro portfolio priorities and benefits realization.
 



 • Ensure Gold Line Metro rail design projects’ objectives are aligned with the RTA strategy, Dubai Strategic Plan, and Rail Network Plan 2032, with a focus on design standards, asset
 



 lifecycle, and infrastructure integration.
 



 • Ensure consistency between program objectives and Dubai’s wider urban development frameworks and approved transport and infrastructure masterplan.
 



 • Ensure Gold Line Metro projects comply with the governance framework and corporate and
 



 technical standards.
 



 • Lead strategic committees for Gold Line Metro projects and coordinate corporate partnerships, memberships, and participation in external forums/agreements; follow up on outputs and performance commitments.
 



 • Oversee tracking and review of program\-level design KPIs, including integration of sustainability requirements, cost\-efficient design solutions, and adherence to approved
 



 design delivery schedules.
 



 • Contribute to the review of construction policies, safety standards, and technical procedures in collaboration with engineering and quality teams.
 



 • Drive the integration of sustainability, environmental, safety, and resilience goals across project planning and execution, ensuring consistent adoption of green design standards, safety compliance, and environmental impact mitigation across the projects.
 



  





 Operations
 



 • Review and track design submissions, contractor mobilization, and work design progress to support delivery milestones.
 



 • Conduct review and provide preliminary approvals on vendor and contractor deliverables to
 



 ensure alignment with program requirements, rail design standards and agreed specifications.
 



 • Monitor Gold Line Metro program lifecycle and performance including milestones, budgets,
 



 resource utilization, risk/challenge analysis and deliverables; prepare progress and
 



 completion reports and highlight deviations and recovery actions to the CEO.
 



 • Provide oversight of value engineering reviews at key stages, reviewing comprehensive reports with recommendations for cost reduction, service improvement, and operational
 



 resilience.
 



 • Oversee and align multidisciplinary rail design, review, and approval process covering architectural, structural, civil, MEP, accessibility, and signage elements including amendments
 



 and updates to ensure compliance.
 



 • Review change orders for Gold Line Metro projects, analyze root causes and justifications, ensure need and data validity, and submit recommendations and reports to the CEO and concerned units.
 



 • Champion and standardize application of value management principles during Gold Line Metro project phases and measure project benefits.
 



 • Manage communication and relationships with government/semi\-government entities and external partners including engineering teams, consultants, and contractors to resolve operational bottlenecks.
 



 • Lead CEO meeting preparation and ensure readiness of required briefs, documents, and presentations.
 



 • Manage complaints, escalations and suggestions for project\-related design issues, contractor delays and technical non\-compliance and risks with internal entities to timely closure.
 



 • Oversee maintenance of documentation repositories and reporting systems to ensure
 



 traceability and transparency across all infrastructure design projects.
 



 • Oversee coordination with internal and external stakeholders, including transport authorities
 



 and urban planners, to ensure multimodal integration, right\-of\-way resolution, and seamless
 



 station connectivity.
 



  





 Product / Process Improvement
 



 • Champion digital transformation and predictive project control by integrating advanced tools
 



 (e.g., BIM, GIS, AI\-enabled project tracking) into design and commercial governance.
 



 • Review performance reports and statistical data to identify challenges and propose actionable
 



 solutions.
 



 • Assist in dissemination of pioneering practices and lessons learned from projects in rail.
 



 • Guide the benchmarking of rail design performance against global best practices and lead
 



 continuous\-improvement initiatives.
 



 • Provide recommendations on AI initiatives (including Proof of Concepts and use\-case
 



 validation); ensure compliance with corporate documents.
 



 • Promote a culture of innovation and motivate departments to adopt cutting\-edge solutions.
 



 • Support capacity\-building sessions and awareness initiatives to strengthen program and
 



 project delivery capabilities.
 



  





 Physical Working Conditions
 



 • Hybrid role with regular field visits, design coordination walkthroughs, site inspections,
 



 testing oversight, and handover reviews to ensure quality compliance, address issues, and
 



 validate design implementation.
 



  





 Education:
 



 Bachelor's degree/ Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, Construction Management or Infrastructure Planning.
 



  





 Experience:
 



 • 12\+ years in case of master’s degree (14\+ years in case of bachelor’s degree).
 



 • Minimum 10 years of experience with at least 5 years of experience in program management in related functional area and 5 years of experience with government agencies.
 



  





 Qualification:
 



 Professional Certificate in Program Management (PgMP), PMP Certificate.

data.jd_text:
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented
 **Associate Director, Project Management** 
 to join our PM/CM Division based in Dubai OR Abu Dhabi, UAE.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced and commercially astute
 **Associate Director, Project Management** 
 to join our Project Management team in either Dubai or Abu Dhabi. This strategic role sits within our Core Office and will be responsible for managing key client relationships, overseeing project delivery during the pre\-construction and early construction phases, and supporting the successful mobilization of Construction Supervision assignments before Resident Engineer deployment.
 



  





 The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring projects are appropriately planned, resourced, governed, and positioned for successful delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





 Client Relationship Management
 


* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, stakeholders, developers, government authorities, and project partners.
* Serve as the primary client interface during project initiation, planning, procurement, and mobilization phases.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships and support business growth initiatives.
* Lead project governance meetings and provide strategic guidance to clients throughout project development.



 Project Leadership \& Delivery
 


* Oversee Construction Supervision from award through mobilization and early delivery stages.
* Ensure effective project planning, execution strategies, resource allocation, and risk management processes are established.
* Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual obligations.
* Support the transition of projects from the Core Office to site\-based delivery teams, including Resident Engineers and project leadership personnel.
* Provide senior\-level oversight and intervention on critical project issues where required.



 Commercial \& Operational Management
 


* Manage project financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, invoicing, profitability, and resource utilization.
* Review and negotiate contracts, consultancy agreements, variations, and commercial matters.
* Ensure compliance with KEO's governance, quality management systems, and project delivery standards.

 Team Leadership
 


* Mentor and support Project Managers and project teams across multiple assignments.
* Promote collaboration across multidisciplinary teams and business units.
* Drive a culture of accountability, excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Support talent development and succession planning initiatives within the Project Management function.



 Risk, Quality \& Governance
 


* Establish project controls, reporting frameworks, and governance structures.
* Identify and proactively manage project risks and mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
* Champion quality assurance and best practice project management methodologies.



  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include minimum 15 years work experience partnered with Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture or related discipline.
 



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

data.jd_text:
**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Technology Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the technology and artificial intelligence sector in the GCC Region. Programming will especially focus on advancing corporate governance; ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and governance\-enabled innovation amongst technology actors and investors. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, planning, and budgeting of the programme strategically aligned with organisation goals and impact objectives ensuring cost\-effectiveness and efficient resource allocation.
* Drive programmatic innovation within existing offering, identifying opportunities to enhance programme effectiveness, efficiency, and impact.
* Identify and enable cross\-programmatic synergies, intersections, and collaborations.
* Identify and integrate subject matter experts, executive trainers and coaches, researchers, and any other third parties to co\-create programmatic projects and deliverables.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 



* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders' engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
* Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
* Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
* Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
* Represent the organization by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
* Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
* Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 



* Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
* Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
* Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
* Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
* Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
* Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 



* Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
* Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.
* Curate and convene the programme’s working group, bringing in together working group members and special guests.
* Monitor the market’s offering, notable trends, and any disruptions to consistently strategically position the programme.
* Produce a consistent pipeline of high\-quality, original bi\-lingual content (e.g., op\-eds, articles, blog posts, white papers, research reports, and working group position papers) that showcases expertise and generates meaningful conversations within the industry.
* Build a strong online presence by actively engaging in priority social media channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, industry\-specific forums) to share content, participate in discussions, and network with other thought leaders.
* Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.



  





**Team mentorship and development** 



* Mentor and coach Programme Associate, providing timely and actionable feedback, creating teachable opportunities, and offering programme career guidance.
* Define and monitor the development plan of Programme Associate, with regular pulse checks, ensuring time and any needed resources are allocated for training.
* Enable career growth, including promotions, for Programme Associate.



  





**Impact measurement and reporting** 



* Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
* Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
* Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
* Analyze data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
* Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
* Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
* Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
* Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.



  





**Tech\-enabled skills development** 



* Proficiently use tools and technology solutions to strengthen team productivity, project management, business development, and research through continuous learning and training.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme development, project management, impact management, storytelling and writing.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme and related special topics.



  





**Qualifications and experience** 



* A master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, and / or the social sciences, or a related discipline, with proven expertise and strong analytical skills.
* Additional certifications in project management, corporate governance, data governance, impact measurement, or technology management are highly desirable.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in managing, coordinating, and executing programs, academic institutions, think tanks, research centers, member\-based networks/councils, or non\-profit organizations.
* Work experience in the private sector, including tech companies, startups, or entrepreneurial ventures is highly desirable.
* Work experience in governance in the tech sector is highly desirable, with a deep understanding of governance and impact frameworks, regulatory compliance, and sustainability practices in the industry.
* Demonstrated experience leading in business development, revenue generation, and / or fundraising for programmes, projects, and / or initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver programmes independently while managing and building relationships with multiple senior market stakeholders, partners, and vendors.
* Demonstrated acumen in AI governance, ethical AI, and emerging regulations in AI/technology, including familiarity with frameworks like ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System), GDPR, and responsible AI practices.
* Expertise in research, impact analysis, impact\-driven programme development, and curriculum design is highly desirable.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and a portfolio of published writings is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required.
* Fluency in Arabic is highly desirable.



  





**Personal attributes** 



* Self\-initiator and self\-learner
* Emotional and social intelligence
* Strategic and solutions\-driven
* Passionate about subject area
* Hardworking and meticulous
* Natural leader and team manager
* Collaborative and adaptive
* Open and transparent communicator
* Purposeful and driven by impact
* Strong work ethic embodying good governance and integrity

**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 Every day is different! As a LoA Coordinator, you are at the first row of GT SU project decisions. You coordinate and moderate the LoA Meetings, advise on process\-related topics and document the management decisions. This will give you the chance to accumulate experience regarding the entire portfolio of our GT SU Execution Unit and to have exposure to management levels, which will give many options to develop your career. Have you become curious?
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Act as interface between business units and functions for all LoA\-related topics, ensuring alignment and clear communication across stakeholders
* Provide active consulting and guidance to project teams on LoA processes and the Salesforce LoA tool
* Drive continuous improvement of the LoA process by identifying optimization potentials and implementing enhancements
* Ensure correct application of the LoA process, including timely submissions, announcements, and validation of data accuracy, completeness, and consistency
* Organize and moderate LoA meetings at management level, including preparation and follow\-up documentation
* Initiate, document, and track LoA approvals in Salesforce, including conditions, comments, and timely execution, and communicate relevant updates to the LoA community


**What You Bring**
* University degree in an engineering or commercial discipline
* Long\-term relevant experience in complex project environments, ideally within interdisciplinary and international project teams across multiple organizational levels
* Strong understanding of bid approval and risk management processes (e.g. PM@SE), including documentation in tools such as Salesforce (preferred)
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and ad hoc requests under time pressure with high diligence and reliability
* Experience in stakeholder management up to senior leadership level and effective collaboration across functions
* Strong analytical, coordination, and communication skills with a proactive, energetic, and results\-driven mindset, as well as solid English skills


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100\.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer\-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self\-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part\-time work or even a sabbatical


 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
   

  

 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
