The Opportunity
   

  

 Responsible for directing Professional and Continuing Education (PaCE) activities, including strategic planning, development, and execution of PaCE programmes, business development, training catalog oversight, and stakeholder engagement, to ensure alignment with market demand, client expectations, and the University’s policies and procedures.
   

  

 The Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic \& Financial
   

  

* Lead the development and monitor the execution of the Department's strategy and align with ZU's strategic objectives, ensuring effective and efficient achievement of departmental operations.
* Oversee the Department’s performance through defined KPIs and targets, and continuously identify and recommend improvements to support the realisation of ZU's strategy.
* Direct the allocation of budget across the Department and ensure full adherence to approved plans and rectify any deviations in a timely manner.
* Provide the relevant organisational unit with consolidated budget input as required, ensuring that the Department’s requirements are appropriately addressed in the overall budget planning process.


 Operational
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of business development strategies to expand B2B and B2C professional training services in line with University’s objectives.
* Lead the establishment of strategic partnerships with industry, government, and community stakeholders to generate revenue, expand reach, and ensure programme sustainability.
* Lead the development of tailored proposals and promotional strategies to position PaCE as a leading provider.
* Direct the development, planning, and internal coordination of full\-scale and customised training programmes to ensure strategic alignment, resource optimisation, and successful delivery of the same.
* Lead the development and delivery of professional education programmes, including short courses, certifications, and hybrid learning models, to meet evolving market demands.
* Lead the engagement with external subject\-matter experts to maintain high\-quality content development and delivery across all training programmes.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised training catalog and digital infrastructure, including LMS platforms, to ensure seamless access to current and upcoming training offerings.
* Direct institutional compliance by ensuring documentation, reporting, and quality assurance mechanisms across all PaCE training activities.
* Direct institutional initiatives that promote faculty and student participation in entrepreneurial training, venture creation, and business incubation programmes offered by the PaCE department.
* Perform ad\-hoc activities related to the job duties, as requested by the direct supervisor.


 People Management
   

  

* Review consolidated workforce planning reports, talent acquisition strategies, and budgets at the Department level to ensure adequate staffing for optimal operational smoothness, and submit to the appropriate authority for final approval.
* Set performance management objectives for all reportees and perform mid\-year and year\-end performance reviews.
* Identify talent for pivotal roles from a succession management standpoint to ensure business continuity.
* Provide guidance to reporting managers on people management matters.
* Manage organisational units within the Department and ensure effective leadership to adequately manage human capital.


 The Requirements
   

  

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience and at least 10 years in a managerial position.
* Certification in a relevant field is preferred.


 The Benefits
   

  

 The University’s benefits package is highly attractive, with competitive tax\-free salaries in the U.A.E., cash housing, annual vacation airline tickets for the employee and immediate family, educational subsidies for children, and healthcare for the employee and sponsored family members.
   

  

 To Apply
   

  

 In addition to completing the online application form, attach a cover letter, a current CV, and the names and contact details of three professional references.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications, you will be contacted only if selected for an interview.
   

  

 For any further inquiries, please contact Recruitment@zu.ac.ae

Eaton’s ES EMEA CPS division is currently seeking a Program Manager Direct Current for Data Center (DC for DC) EMEA.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The DC for DC EMEA Program Manager is responsible for orchestrating and governing Eaton’s end to end data center electrical solution portfolio for hyperscale and colocation customers across EMEA. This role ensures that product development, system architectures, and customer engagement activities across multiple Eaton divisions are aligned into a coherent, competitive, and execution ready offering.
   

  

 Operating as a senior, technical program leader with strong systems engineering credibility, the Program Manager leads through influence across R\&D, product management, engineering, and commercial teams. The role owns program execution from concept through launch, ensuring on schedule and on budget delivery, structured customer engagement at each development milestone, and rapid identification and resolution of technical or organizational gaps.
   

  

 This is a newly created, strategic role reporting directly to the VP/GM, with a mandate to strengthen Eaton’s position with hyperscalers and colocation customers by driving integrated solutions rather than disconnected products.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**DC for DC EMEA Program Leadership:**
* Establish and lead the DC for DC EMEA program covering Eaton’s full data center power value chain, including MVSST, 800VDC Switchboard, DC Remote Power Panel, Solid State Breakers, BESS, Busway, digital power management, and related software and services.
* Define clear program governance, milestones, success criteria, and escalation mechanisms across participating divisions.
* Ensure the program is executed on schedule and within approved budgets, with disciplined tracking of progress, risks, and dependencies.


**Cross Division Product \& Technology Alignment**
* Coordinate new product development roadmaps across multiple Eaton divisions to ensure architectural coherence and compatibility for hyperscale and colocation data center applications.
* Work closely with divisional R\&D, power systems engineering, and product management teams to align technical assumptions, interfaces, and performance targets.
* Identify portfolio gaps, overlaps, or misalignments impacting customer requirements and drive resolution through structured action plans and executive escalation where required.


**Customer Engagement \& External Alignment**
* Ensure structured and continuous customer engagement throughout the product and solution development lifecycle, including concept validation, architecture reviews, pilot phases, and launch readiness.
* Act as a senior technical interface for hyperscale and colocation customers in EMEA, ensuring customer feedback is systematically captured and translated into product and program actions.
* Coordinate with regional teams in APAC and the Americas to align customer learnings, program progress, and best practices globally.


**Program Execution, Visibility \& Issue Resolution**
* Consolidate inputs from divisions into clear program dashboards, executive summaries, and decision materials for senior leadership.
* Proactively identify technical, organizational, or execution risks and lead cross functional teams to resolve issues before customer or market impact.
* Drive disciplined follow up on actions, ensuring accountability and closure across divisional stakeholders.


**Strategic Contribution \& Continuous Improvement**
* Contribute to Eaton’s long term data center strategy by providing insights from customer engagements, competitive dynamics, and technology trends.
* Support continuous improvement of Eaton’s data center go to market model by strengthening integration between product, engineering, and customer facing teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10–15 years of experience in power systems, electrical infrastructure, or data center technology environments.
* Proven experience working with hyperscale and/or colocation data center customers.
* Prior experience in R\&D, advanced engineering, systems engineering, or complex technical program leadership roles.


**Skills**
* Strong understanding of data center electrical architectures, including MV and LV distribution, ACBs, UPS systems, energy storage, busway, and redundancy concepts.
* Ability to ensure system level technical coherence through collaboration with divisional experts rather than hands on detailed design ownership.
* Credibility based leadership and the ability to lead through influence in a matrix organization.
* Strong program management discipline and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate confidently with senior internal leaders and demanding external customers.
* Structured, action oriented mindset with a strong bias toward execution and issue resolution.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Company Description** 
 The Knowledge Society (TKS) is a global innovation program for ambitious teenagers focused on solving real\-world challenges. Over a 10\-month experience, TKS helps students become capable innovators and leaders by engaging with 40\+ emerging technologies and working on impactful projects with organizations like Microsoft, Interac, and the United Nations. The program emphasizes experimentation, building, and creating meaningful solutions rather than memorization, and is designed by leaders from McKinsey, Google, and Stanford to mirror the culture of top startups like SpaceX and DeepMind. Since 2016, TKS has supported more than 4,000 students across 60\+ countries through in\-person and global virtual programs, cultivating a diverse community centered on leadership, growth, and innovation. The organization is rapidly growing and expanding its reach, offering team members the chance to shape the future of youth innovation at scale.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Associate Director role at TKS is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Dubai, UAE. This role is responsible for supporting the Dubai Program Director in delivering the 10\-month TKS program to \~160 students. Our directors have a passion for unlocking potential, want to help make a difference in the world, and have unique backgrounds/experiences.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* **Program Facilitation:** 
 Collaborate with the Program Director to facilitate the program and deliver engaging weekly sessions to students.
* **Experiential Opportunities:** 
 Design and execute unique, hands\-on learning experiences such as attending conferences, hosting guest speakers, and organizing tours of companies or labs, as feasible.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Serve as a primary point of contact for parents, mentors, and partners, ensuring timely and clear communication to align on program goals and student success.
* **Student Mentorship:** 
 Provide personalized mentorship, guidance, and constructive feedback to accelerate student growth in both project work and personal development.
* **Logistical Support:** 
 Assist the Program Director in managing logistics for unique student experiences, such as conferences, events, guest speaker sessions, and industry or lab tours.
* **Student Recruitment:** 
 Actively recruit driven and high\-potential students by building relationships with schools, leveraging community networks, hosting information sessions, and developing strategic partnerships, alongside reviewing applications and conducting interviews to select the best candidates for the program.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 2\-5 years of professional work experience, preferably in education, technology, or program management.
* **Program Expertise:** 
 Experience in implementing and leading engaging programs or initiatives.



  





**Traits:** 




  




* **Passion for Education and Technology:** 
 A deep interest in education, emerging technologies, and cultivating the next generation of leaders and innovators.
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and connect with diverse groups of students, stakeholders, and partners.
* **Adaptability:** 
 Ability to adapt, figure things out, and thrive in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

**Job Description**
 Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.

**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Family Firms Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the family businesses sector, including supporting next\-generation leaders, in the GCC Region. Programming will especially focus on building the long\-term success and resilience of family enterprises by advancing corporate governance, ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and innovation. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, and execution of the Governance in Family Firms programme, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and strategic objectives.
* Continuously innovate and enhance the programme offering, identifying opportunities for improvement and greater impact in family firm governance.
* Develop and implement programme strategies that address emerging trends and challenges faced by family businesses, ensuring relevance and long\-term sustainability.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts, external consultants, and partners to co\-create high\-quality programme content and deliverables.
* Identify synergies between the programme and other organisational initiatives to drive greater impact across multiple sectors.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 



* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders’ engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
* Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
* Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
* Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
* Represent the organisation by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
* Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.

**About GTN**

Our platform is designed for buy\- and sell\-side financial institutions and fintech companies, such as digital banks, wallet providers and neo brokers, offering a seamless experience across trading, wealth management, and API solutions.

The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Is
data.jd_text:
The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

 At Jumeirah, dining is curated as a collection of exceptional destinations, where each signature restaurant offers a distinct expression of culinary artistry and refined luxury. Across Dubai, guests are invited to experience a world of rare flavours, immersive atmospheres, and thoughtfully crafted moments, where global cuisines are reimagined with precision and creativity.  An exciting opportunity has arisen for an
 **Executive Director of F\&B Marketing**

**Role:** 




 An Associate Director in Financial Crime Risk in Supervision is responsible for executing the Financial Crime Risk Team’s work plan. The Associate Director must ensure that a risk based, proportionate and efficient approach is maintained towards all the team’s supervisory activities.
 



  





 An Associate Director is expected to oversee assigned regulatory projects related to financial crime risk and relevant business model within the team, across the Supervision Department and the DFSA, as well as supporting on related policy work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 The Associate Director is expected to devote the majority of his/her time towards managerial and operational level tasks, as well as support policy development. The Associate Director will assist the Director and contribute to the work of the team with the following key responsibilities:
 



  






 Technical Guidance
 



* Act as a technical expert in respective risk area and provide internal trainings as needed.
* Provide guidance to the team in all aspects of financial crime risk for regulated entities in order to ensure delivery of effective and efficient risk\-based supervision.
* Support DFSA Divisions by providing guidance in all aspects of financial crime risk in line with the DFSA’s objectives.
* Monitor developments in relevant international and regional regulatory standards and in the financial services industry and provide inputs and updates.



  






 Strategy Formulation, Implementation, Planning and Projects
 




  




* Contribute to DFSA\-wide and Supervision Division\-wide strategic direction, business planning and policy formation. Ensure effective cascading of approved strategy, business plans and policies into the day\-to\-day management of the team.
* Participate in the development and implementation of supervision strategy for the team, consistent with the DFSA\-wide goals and objectives.
* Ensure DFSA\-wide projects as captured in the Business Plan relevant to the AD are completed effectively, on\-time and within budget.
* Be expected to devote a considerable level of time toward managerial, policy, outreach and other assigned projects.



  






 People Management
 



* Manage and support the effective achievement of the objectives of respective areas of focus through setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, provision of formal and informal feedback and appraisal in order to maximize subordinate and the overall performance.
* Ensure the key performance indicators, performance reviews, leave approvals and timesheets are completed in an accurate and timely manner for self and team members.
* Support the professional development programs of the DFSA through program development, delivery and participation. Support and contribute to the DFSA graduates training program.
* When requested, effectively lead the team in the absence of the Director.



  





**Educational Background** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management or Economics. A post graduate degree in similar fields would be considered as an advantage.
* Evidence of continuing professional education relevant to target position.
* Professional qualifications in finance, risk management, quantitative analysis, etc. such as ACAMS, CFA, FRM, PRM, etc. would be considered as a plus.



  





**Professional Experience** 



* 10\+ years of regulatory, compliance or risk management experience required in a broadly equivalent financial services regulator and/or a regulated entity, with a minimum of 2 years in managerial/ supervisory roles in one or more of these functions being desirable. Managerial roles might include project leadership / management roles or equivalent with a demonstrated ability to mentor and motivate staff.
* Experience in dealing with financial services regulators, standard setters and members of Board of Directors and senior executives.
* Preferably experience in the development and implementation of regulatory standards and policy analysis.
* Experience of country self\-assessments against the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) 40 recommendations; national risk assessments pursuant to FATF Recommendation 1; and involvement with a FATF country mutual evaluation would be considered an advantage.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 



* Strong and up to date knowledge and technical expertise in dealing with financial services regulations and relevant international standard setters.
* Robust understanding of the responsibilities/role of the regulator and of what it means to be a risk\-based regulator.
* An in\-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and its unique characteristics with proven technical knowledge and understanding of the key risks in the sector.
* Deep understanding of current and emerging risk management trends/issues.
* Appreciation of the unique features of the regulatory regime in the DIFC and understanding of the nature of the financial service activities offered by Authorised Firms operating in the DIFC.
* Strategic vision, strong analytical thinking and creativity; capacity to clearly articulate options and trade\-offs and ability to apply judgment.
* Influential skills and ability to lead meetings and deliver difficult messages, when necessary.
* Excellent people leadership, planning, organisation and time management skills embodied in a professional, diplomatic and ethical attitude.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to address senior executives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including ability to engage effectively and confidently with international counterparts.
* Capacity to deliver high quality work to demanding timescales.
* Be able to work flexibility, autonomously, and co\-operatively in a collaborative team environment.

Ignite School is expanding with the opening of a new purpose\-built
 **Pre\-K to Grade 1 campus** 
 located adjacent to our existing campus in Dubai. The new campus is currently under construction and is scheduled to open for the
 **2027/28 academic year** 
 .
 



 The appointed
 **School Director / Principal** 
 will join Ignite School during the
 **2026/27 academic year** 
 and will play a key leadership role in preparing the new campus for a successful opening. Working closely with the
 **Board of Trustees, KHDA, and the existing school leadership team** 
 , the Director will ensure that all regulatory, operational, staffing, and educational requirements are completed in line with approved standards and timelines.
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity for an experienced and visionary educational leader to help establish the culture, systems, policies, and learning environment of a new early years and elementary campus from its inception.
 



 The new
 **820\-seat campus** 
 has been designed to provide a modern, student\-centered learning environment that supports inquiry, collaboration, creativity, and early childhood development. Facilities will include dedicated learning spaces, specialist teaching areas, a parent and staff café, and extensive outdoor play and exploration areas.
 



**Role Overview** 




**The School Director / Principal will be responsible for the overall strategic direction, leadership, management, and efficient operation of the new campus. The role includes ensuring KHDA compliance, leading operational readiness, supporting student recruitment and enrolment growth, overseeing staff planning and recruitment, and ensuring a smooth transition for students, families, and staff into the new facility.** 




**As the KHDA\-nominated Principal, the Director will serve as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, compliance matters, inspections, and regulatory visits. The Director will also be ultimately accountable for the campus’s health, safety, wellbeing, standards, performance, and continuous improvement.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**New Campus Development and Opening Readiness** 



* Lead the planning and preparation required for the successful opening of the new Pre\-K to Grade 1 campus.
* Work closely with the Board of Trustees and KHDA to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.
* Develop, adapt, and implement campus policies, procedures, systems, and operational readiness plans.
* Support the transition of staff, students, and families to the new campus.
* Oversee student recruitment, admissions planning, and enrolment growth for the new campus.
* Ensure the campus is fully prepared across academic, operational, staffing, compliance, facilities, and parent communication areas.



**Strategic Leadership and School Management** 



* Lead the implementation of the school’s mission, vision, and approved education plan.
* Provide clear strategic direction and ensure effective organizational management.
* Monitor school performance through key performance indicators and improvement targets.
* Ensure high standards in teaching, learning, student wellbeing, safeguarding, and operational delivery.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and culturally respectful school environment.
* Maintain a strong focus on Emirati culture, Arabic language, Islamic values, and UAE national priorities.



**KHDA Compliance and Regulatory Accountability** 



* Serve as the KHDA\-nominated Principal on the school’s Educational Services Permit.
* Act as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, inspections, visits, and compliance matters.
* Ensure all school records are accurate, updated, and available to KHDA when required.
* Ensure full compliance with KHDA, UAE regulatory requirements, safeguarding standards, health and safety expectations, and internal school policies.
* Oversee the implementation of policies related to admissions, health and safety, inclusion, wellbeing, safeguarding, curriculum, assessment, teaching, complaints, and student support.



**Teaching, Learning, and Student Outcomes** 



* Ensure high\-quality teaching, learning, and educational provision across the campus.
* Monitor student progress, achievement, wellbeing, and engagement.
* Ensure the needs of all students are met, including Emirati students, students of determination, high\-performing students, and students requiring additional support.
* Lead the continuous improvement of curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and learning outcomes.
* Support the development of a child\-centered learning environment that promotes inquiry, creativity, collaboration, and early childhood development.



**Parent Partnership and Community Engagement** 



* Build strong, positive relationships with parents and the wider school community.
* Promote effective communication between the Director’s office, families, staff, and stakeholders.
* Lead parent engagement initiatives, meetings, events, and service recovery discussions when required.
* Use parent feedback, surveys, and evaluation data to support timely school improvement.
* Strengthen parent satisfaction, loyalty, and student re\-registration.



**Operational and Financial Management** 



* Ensure effective use of school resources to support educational and operational priorities.
* Manage campus operations in line with approved budgets and school expectations.
* Support enrolment targets, re\-registration, fee collection, and efficient resource allocation.
* Monitor facilities, health and safety, and service quality to ensure a safe and high\-quality school environment.
* Identify operational challenges and allocate resources effectively to support school success.



**Staffing, Performance, and Human Resources** 



* Lead the recruitment and appointment of suitably qualified staff in line with KHDA and school requirements.
* Support the formation and development of the campus leadership and administrative teams.
* Oversee staff performance management, probation reviews, annual evaluations, and professional development.
* Promote staff retention, accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
* Manage staff\-related matters in line with school HR policies, including performance concerns, disciplinary matters, grievances, and allegations against staff.



**School Improvement and Accreditation** 



* Lead the development and implementation of the School Improvement Plan.
* Support DSIB inspection readiness and continuous progress toward strong inspection outcomes.
* Contribute to maintaining and strengthening NEASC accreditation standards.
* Use data, feedback, and evaluation outcomes to drive measurable improvement.
* Ensure improvement actions are followed up, monitored, and completed to a high standard.



**Candidate Profile** 



* **The ideal candidate will be an experienced educational leader with a strong background in early years and elementary education, school start\-up or campus development, American curriculum leadership, and UAE regulatory compliance. The candidate should demonstrate strong strategic thinking, excellent communication, sound judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to build trust with staff, parents, students, regulators, and the wider school community.**

data.jd_text:
You have previously articulated a clear academic vision and taken ownership of its results. You have led visibly and decisively, not from the margins. Your work in learning science is substantive—you have designed operational systems, produced measurable outcomes, and represented that work publicly with confidence. If this describes your career, 2 Hour Learning seeks its Director of Academic Excellence.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning operates on a model in which students achieve learning outcomes twice as quickly, dedicating just two hours daily. This is made possible through AI\-driven tutoring, mastery\-based learning pathways, and a departure from traditional classroom methods. Performance data validates the approach. We now require a leader capable of aligning execution across varied school implementations, elevating academic standards across teams, and serving as the authoritative voice for a model rooted in evidence\-based learning science.
   

  

 This position is not conceptual. It is operational and strategic. You will take full ownership of academic execution, establish performance benchmarks, diagnose implementation challenges, and develop leadership teams to deliver tangible results. You will translate the scientific principles underlying our work into consistent operational practice and advocate for the model in high\-stakes external forums.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Designing academic frameworks that operationalize learning science principles into actionable guidance for curriculum design, motivational architecture, and application functionality.
* Conducting structured academic execution reviews with Heads of Academics to ensure alignment, accountability, and measurable progress across all school teams.
* Integrating quantitative data, qualitative interviews, and direct observation into comprehensive academic ecosystem assessments that identify high\-impact barriers to learning acceleration and recommend targeted interventions.
* Ensuring strategic coherence through continuous planning, structured feedback mechanisms, and milestone oversight to sustain focus on student learning objectives.
* Serving as the senior representative of 2 Hour Learning in external forums—including keynote presentations and engagements with Ministries of Education—to influence global discourse on educational transformation.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Engaging in narrow curriculum revisions that do not contribute to broader systemic improvement.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from measurable student outcomes or operational implementation.
* Transferring accountability for team performance to mid\-level managers or external advisors.
* Depending on institutional reputation or conceptual arguments to convince critical audiences.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and refine 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by aligning execution across all school sites, raising leadership performance standards, and establishing yourself as the authoritative public representative of a movement founded on rigorous learning science and demonstrated outcomes.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

data.jd_text:
Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
   

  

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.


* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
+ Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
+ Driving Financial performance
+ Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What we offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance


**Are you our new colleague?**
 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
   

  

 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
   

  

 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
   

  

***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
As the Director of Technical Services, you will be responsible for the strategy and execution of technical services by employees of the Services Department in various FreeBalance Customer locations throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Key to this position is the ability to supervise and provide technical advice to the Vice President of Global Services department who oversees all FreeBalance customer project implementations worldwide. Responsibilities include building technical strategies, models, and approaches with team members operating out of the Headquarters of FreeBalance in Ottawa and ensuring its implementation and execution with all FreeBalance Technical Consultants overseas. This position is part of the Services Leadership team that works with the Solution Team in Ottawa and overseas (mainly in the EMEA region) alongside the individual project managers who manage the entire lifecycle of the implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite that addresses the Public Financial Management reform that FreeBalance customers undertake and implement.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Preparation of strategies and design for data migration that can be implemented by the FreeBalance Technical Consultants at a client location.
* Build tools and models for the Installation and Deployment of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite that can be leveraged for project deliveries.
* Collaborate with the Research and Development Team to design the interface components during the implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite.
* Collaborate with the Technical and Functional Consultants to create the training curriculum that can be delivered to the customers.
* Manage the day\-to\-day tasks of the team.
* Work with the Project Managers to design the rollout of the system for decentralized operations.
* Managing the Operations \& maintenance team in EMEA and provide management oversight to the remote team worldwide.
* Manage the technical tools and research and develop new tools for use by the Technical Consultants.
* Build scalable models for implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite at the Data Centre and Disaster Recovery Sites where the software is hosted.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure consistency, quality and timeliness of customer deliveries, internal policies and communications.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Extensive travel is required


**Qualifications**
* University degree in Information Technology.
* Proven experience reviewing and developing Support and Maintenance policies and procedures.
* 5 years of experience successfully managing an internationally dispersed Services and Support Team
* Project Management experience a must
* Ability to clearly articulate at meetings with all levels of management and stakeholders.
* Experience with goal\-setting frameworks like Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).
* Experienced in working with open\-source software components such as Tomcat, BIRT and commercial middleware such as MS SQL and Oracle databases with Windows Operating Systems
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Able to travel internationally.
* PMI Certification
* Other IT certifications


 We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. FreeBalance is an inclusive employer dedicated to building a diverse workforce to increase the representation of the designated groups based on each country’s legislation. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective labour law throughout all stages of the recruitment process.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 **Operations Director**

 Care\+ is not a warranty department.

 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.

 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦

 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)

 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure

data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences. A key focus is the governance and execution of integrated product and platform roadmaps across these domains to drive long\-term value creation.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.
 



  





**Role Relationships:** 




  




* Group CTO, Group and Vertical Technology Teams, Strategy \& Value Creation, Business Verticals, Technology Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud \& Platform Providers
* 4\-5 Direct Reports



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Group Digital Engineering \& Platform Strategy** 




  




* Define and own the enterprise\-wide Digital Engineering strategy aligned to Group and vertical priorities
* Establish strategic direction across core domains: AI \& Data Platforms, ERP \& Enterprise Systems, Integration \& APIs, Digital Products, Service Orchestration
* Drive platform consolidation, standardisation, and reuse across business units
* Translate business priorities into coherent cross\-domain platform strategies



  





**Product Roadmap Ownership \& Strategic Alignment** 



* Own definition, governance, and execution of product and platform roadmaps
* Align technology investments with business value creation objectives
* Prioritise initiatives based on ROI, strategic importance, and enterprise impact
* Eliminate duplication and fragmentation through centralised roadmap governance



  





**AI \& Intelligent Platform Enablement** 




  




* Define and execute the Group AI strategy across enterprise platforms
* Identify and scale high\-value data and AI use cases (automation, personalisation, analytics)
* Establish AI platform capabilities including data foundations, model lifecycle, and MLOps
* Drive enterprise adoption of AI\-enabled services



  





**ERP \& Core Enterprise Platforms** 




  




* Own strategy, operation and transformation of ERP platforms (Oracle) and adjacent systems
* Lead consolidation, simplification, and standardisation across business entities in line with Enterprise Architectural patterns
* Ensure ERP technology\-stack supports scalable, integrated, and efficient business operations
* Review and align ERP roadmap with business capability needs



  





**Integration Services \& Enterprise Connectivity** 




  




* Define and lead Group\-wide integration strategy (APIs, middleware, event\-driven architecture)
* Build, operate and scale integration platforms (API gateways, iPaaS) (Informatica, Frends)
* Establish standardised integration patterns to eliminate complexity
* Enable seamless interoperability across enterprise and vertical systems



  





**Digital Products \& Services** 




  




* Lead strategy and delivery of Group IT digital product platforms
* Define product operating models, lifecycle management, and engineering frameworks
* Drive development of scalable, reusable digital services
* Align digital product outcomes with growth, engagement, and customer experience
* Evaluate, implement and scale blockchain and tokenisation platforms to support digital asset enablement, new business models, and ecosystem partnerships with Strategy \& Value Creation



  





**Service Orchestration \& Platform Operating Model** 




  




* Define and implement service orchestration capabilities (ServiceNow)
* Enable end\-to\-end service delivery across ERP, integration, and digital layers
* Establish frameworks to unify fragmented workflows and services
* Drive adoption of platform\-based operating models



  





**Engineering Excellence \& Delivery** 




  




* Establish best\-in\-class engineering practices (DevSecOps, CI/CD, agile delivery)
* Drive engineering quality, productivity, and scalability
* Lead complex transformation programmes across multiple entities
* Ensure delivery aligns with strategic priorities and roadmap commitment



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication** 




  




* Act as a trusted advisor to Group CTO and senior leadership across the Group
* Translate technology strategies into clear business outcomes
* Align stakeholders across technology, product, and business domains
* Provide executive\-level communication and reporting



  





**Vendor \& Partner Ecosystem** 




  




* Define and manage strategic partnerships (ERP, cloud, AI, platforms)
* Oversee system integrators and delivery partners
* Ensure vendor accountability, performance, and value realisation
* Continuously scout market for potential future technologies and partners to support the long\-term Group IT Strategy



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




  




* 12–15\+ years in large\-scale enterprise technology delivery and operations
* 8–10\+ years in senior leadership roles managing large engineering and product organisations
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation programmes
* Experience in complex, multi\-entity organisations (real\-estate, hospitality, construction or similar sectors preferred)



  





**Education/Professional Certification:** 









**Minimum requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field
* Master’s Degree (MBA or MSc) strongly preferred
* PMP / PRINCE2
* ITIL v4
* TOGAF or Enterprise Architecture certifications
* Agile / SAFe certifications
* 



**Technical Competencies:** 




  




* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Evolved organisational awareness and stakeholder management



  





 Deep expertise across:
 



  




* AI \& Data Platforms (Foundry, MS Fabric, MLOPs)
* ERP Systems (Oracle)
* Integration Architecture (APIs, middleware, event\-driven systems)
* Digital Product Platforms (Webflow/Acquia)
* Service orchestration and platform operating models (ServiceNow)
* Experience blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and tokenisation frameworks, including their integration into enterprise platforms and digital product ecosystems
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, and DevSecOps
* Ability to define and execute multi\-domain enterprise platform strategies



  





**Behavioural Competencies:** 




  




* Strong executive presence and influence at C\-suite level
* Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
* Ability to operate in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills
* Results\-oriented with high accountability
* Proven ability to build and lead high\-performing teams



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




  





**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

data.jd_text:
I am currently looking for an experienced
 **Project Director** 
 to lead the successful delivery of several High\-Rise projects across Dubai. This is a senior leadership position suited to an individual with a proven background in delivery of High\-Rise buildings from construction stage through to successful handover.
 



  





 The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all site activities, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality. You will act as a key point of contact between clients, consultants, and project teams while providing strategic leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of complex, large\-scale construction projects, overseeing all site operations from mobilisation through to completion and handover.
* Manage project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and consultants to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and implement project strategies, programmes, schedules, and delivery plans aligned with client expectations and contractual requirements.
* Monitor project budgets, commercial performance, resource allocation, and overall project progress.
* Oversee contract administration, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, variations, claims, and project requirements.
* Identify potential project risks and implement effective mitigation strategies to protect programme, cost, and quality objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Lead coordination between design, commercial, construction, and technical teams to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with Dubai construction regulations, authority requirements, health \& safety standards, and quality procedures.
* Drive best practices across project delivery, improving processes, efficiency, and overall project performance.
* Provide clear reporting and project updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Mentor and develop project teams, creating a high\-performance and collaborative working environment.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 18 years’ experience within construction, project management, or supervision, with a strong track record delivering major developments.
* Previous experience operating as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager on High\-Rise projects is a Must.
* Strong Middle East experience is essential, with proven knowledge of the Dubai construction market.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, project controls, planning, cost management, and risk mitigation.
* Ability to manage large multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent client\-facing skills with experience dealing directly with developers, consultants, subcontractors, and government authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision\-making abilities.



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for an established Project Director to play a key role in delivering high\-rise developments in Dubai.

data.jd_text:
Role Purpose
 
 The MEP Project Manager is responsible for the overall planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works on construction projects. The role ensures that MEP systems are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual, technical, quality, and safety requirements. The MEP Project Manager leads MEP teams and coordinates with all stakeholders to achieve successful project delivery.
 


 Key Accountabilities
 
**Project Management \& Planning** 



* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of MEP works from design review to commissioning and handover.
* Review MEP contract documents, drawings, specifications, and BOQs.
* Prepare MEP execution plans, project schedules, manpower plans, and procurement strategies.
* Monitor progress against approved schedules and take corrective actions as needed.



**Technical Oversight** 



* Ensure proper implementation of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire fighting, ELV, and BMS systems.
* Resolve technical and coordination issues in collaboration with consultants and design teams.
* Review and approve shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements.



**Coordination \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Coordinate MEP works with civil, architectural, and structural teams to avoid clashes and delays.
* Liaise with clients, consultants, authorities, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Lead MEP coordination meetings and contribute to overall project meetings.



**Cost \& Commercial Management** 



* Control MEP budgets and monitor costs, variations, and claims.
* Review subcontractor payments, variations, and final accounts.
* Support procurement activities and evaluate technical and commercial offers.



**Quality, Testing \& Commissioning** 



* Ensure implementation of QA/QC procedures for all MEP works.
* Oversee testing, commissioning, and system integration activities.
* Manage snagging, defects rectification, and final handover documentation (O\&M manuals, as\-built drawings).



**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure strict compliance with HSE policies and statutory requirements.
* Promote safe working practices and lead safety initiatives on site.


 Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge \& Skills
 * Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (Master’s degree is a plus).
* 15\+ years of experience in MEP works within construction projects.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale commercial, residential, hospitality, or mixed\-use projects.
* Strong knowledge of international standards and local authority regulations.

* Ensure the supervision consultants are discharging their onsite duties in accordance with their contracted services.

* Project Reporting: Able to prepare and present reports for the wider organisation to update progress on projects status
* Risk Management: An appreciation of risks and understanding of how to document them, including mitigation plans to ensure projects are delivered within their respective constraints.

 At Dubai Holding, we're committed to nurturing the success and well\-being of our colleagues. Join our dynamic and diverse team, and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, career development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We strongly believe in creating an empowered workforce that will help us build a connected city for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing the most pioneering candidates who desire to make a great impact on the future of Dubai.
