data.jd_text:
Inhabit is a unique, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals who are passionate about making a positive contribution to our built environment.
   

  





 We are a collective of experienced architects, designers, engineers and detailers who work both independently and in partnership to form a holistic approach to the services that we offer. We believe that our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society.
   

  





 We are focused on design\-led engineering, providing technical and comprehensive solutions that thoughtfully and creatively consider aesthetics, engineering, cost, procurement, and sustainability driving towards a building that is sensitive and inspirational within its socio\-cultural context.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**List of Responsibilities**




 The Associate Director forms part of the engineering team within the global structure of the company and assumes responsibilities that pro\-actively contribute to the growth of Façade Engineering and specialist design and engineering team within the global structure of the Inhabit and Egis company structure.
   

  





 The role assumes both KPI based and general responsibilities that actively contribute to project technical and commercial delivery, compliance, functional wellbeing, advancement and growth of facade discipline and all other specialist and general disciplines.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for all design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken for façade and all other disciplines. You will lead, develop, and manage a team of approx. (5\-10\) direct reports. You may also need to fulfil any legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for team engagement and growth, technical excellence, ethics, project leadership, design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken by the facade team. You will also need to fulfill legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 The following is an overview of responsibilities and performance standards required of the Associate Director:
   

  




* Major Function
* Project Operation / Management
* Strategic Management
* Financial Management
* Marketing and Business Development
* Staff Management, Mentoring and Training
* Client Management
* Project Management
* Consultancy Function
* Technical Excellence
* Personal Growth



**Major Function**




 Duties include but not limited to:
   

  





  

  




* Represent Inhabit on projects with clients and provide technical leadership and assistance to ensure projects meet high quality standards and are managed in accordance with timeframes and budget parameters
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Create, build and maintain business opportunities
* Manage projects and resources to ensure professional services are achieved and deliver high quality focused services on projects to ensure client satisfaction and repeat business
* Participate in a yearly management meeting to develop and contribute to strategic business planning and to set personal KPI’s relevant to your role
* Report to the Director on your performance and the performance of the team as directed
* Attend meetings with clients to manage projects according to Inhabits scope of services
* Provide training and mentoring to the team as the need arises always promoting inclusion and growth for all staff under your leadership
* Prepare project proposals including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines and report these bids / wins / losses to the Director
* Maintain regular contact with existing or prospective clients for establishing potential future work
* Active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions to enhance the professional image of Inhabit
* Assist the Director with staff performance reviews
* Carry out research on potential materials and share knowledge and update technical library
* Keep up to date with relevant design software and products new to the market that will help develop our business
* Maintain an intimate knowledge of relevant codes and standards
* Continually strive to improve technical knowledge and encourage team technical discussions
* Evaluate opportunities for improved efficiencies and effectiveness in consultation with the Director including identifying, developing and implementing standards, systems, tools and processes to support improvement within the business
* Take an active interest in the other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc.) to further develop your specialist skills



**Project Operation/ Management**




 You shall be responsible for profitable completion of all projects and tasks under your control whilst maintaining excellent technical standards and client satisfaction. Detailed responsibilities and/or targets include:
   

  




* Assist in the management of the project team in terms of time and cost
* Cost planning and outputs required to meet project budgets
* Business Development and marketing material preparation
* Managing clients to secure work, marketing and fee proposals
* Updating of the administrative systems for recording proposal activities
* Allocation and management of time to suit programs and project budgets
* Ensure projects are completed on\-time and without cost overrun
* Ensure high technical standing on the project such that client complaints do not arise.



**Strategic Management**




 The Associate Director will contribute to short and long\-term regional planning and assist in driving forward the strategy that embodies Inhabit’s values, vision, mission and objectives to successfully grow the business including:
   

  




* Assist in developing the regional business plan aligned to Inhabit strategic plan to be approved by the Regional Manager. Assist in setting regional objectives and in preparing and implementing strategies to achieve the business plan. Ensure staff are well informed and up to date on developments that affect them
* Assist in undertaking regional future workforce planning and projects with an emphasis on growth and innovation.



**Financial Management**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the proper financial management including:
   

  





  

  




* Assist in the development and implementation of annual budgets and ensure that adequate internal control mechanisms are in place
* Monitor financial aspects of projects including monthly invoicing to ensure the accuracy and debtor collection
* Follow up with clients on overdue fees for debtors greater than 90 days
* Assist in reviewing and monitoring monthly financial reports
* Assisting in managing business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to signing (and following award of) any consulting commission



**Marketing and Business Development**




 The Associate Director shall actively participate in the marketing of the practice as a multi\-disciplined engineering company and shall achieve agreed targets in all aspects of practice development, including:
   

  




* Maximise cross\-selling opportunities for Inhabit and prepare project proposals to support profit targets including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc)
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Raise any challenges in competitive pricing across the region with the Regional Manager and propose solutions
* Build and expand the client base of Inhabit based on both established, prospective and new client relationships that you secure in the region
* Network within the Industry to develop industry intelligence, define and implement strategies to meet any challenges
* Ensure active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions, networking events, conferences, seminars, committees etc. to enhance the professional image of both the Associate Director and Inhabit



**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**




 The Associate Director is responsible for ensuring staff are managed and supported effectively including:
   

  




* Encourage and role model respectful, supportive and positive engagement and interactions across disciplines/support functions and all other Inhabit offices to support positive culture and drive engagement
* Identify the deliverables, tasks and activities required for workload throughout all phases of the project to ensure adequate staff resourcing and tools are available to meet project deliverables and expectations
* Recruitment activities (with prior approval from the Regional Manager and Regional Director, Australia and New Zealand) in accordance with company procedures
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, mentoring and support and build and oversee staff technical development to maintain standards and to operate efficiently
* Ensure staff are following Inhabit’s quality management system
* Hold regular meetings with the Technical Team to discuss scheduling of work in a planned manner including distribution of workload, resources etc. to meet deliverables
* Assist in setting objectives and standards for the expected performance of staff and encourage regular feedback discussions on project successes and challenges to capture lessons learned

* Identify training needs of the team to increase their skill level, development and growth
* Identify training opportunities, both internally and externally including seminars, events, conferences, talks, university lectures, factory visits, construction phase training etc., to assist with the development of the team and to address any knowledge and skill gaps. Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences
* Encourage and promote Inhabit online materials, technical notes, technical library
* Communicate regularly and proactively with Senior Management as required to assist the process of managing your work/lifestyle balance and of your team
* Ensure staff adhere to and are familiar with all Health and Safety requirements and safe work practices



**Client Management**




 The Associate Director shall continually strengthen client loyalty and gain repeat business by ensuring high quality service and creative (‘Leading Edge’) solutions to clients by way of:
   

  




* Communicate with clients to establish their needs and maintain a dialogue throughout the project
* Monitor feedback from clients and develop and implement action plans for continuous improvement
* Identify and implement ways to enhance current service offerings, systems and processes from a client and business perspective to maximise Inhabit’s competitive advantage
* Identify and implement ways to enhance internal systems, processes and procedures to improve client satisfaction
* Be a role model for exceptional favourable record in client response to timeliness, quality of work and high technical standing on projects and manage in conjunction with Project Director/Leader any client complaints
* Continually aim for repeat and new business from all clients in contact with Inhabit



**Project Management**




 The Associate Director will provide leadership to ensure the efficient and profitable completion of all tasks and projects under their control whilst ensuring the allocation of adequate resources, excellent technical standards and client satisfaction including:
   

  




* Provide overall strategy and technical solutions as required for project challenges
* Undertake or assist the project leaders with negotiation of fees and contracts where appropriate to ensure financial targets are achieved

* Oversee the work of Sub Consultants/Contractors and review outputs produced by them
* Ensure project sheets for each project are undertaken for compliance with project and office QA procedures



**Consultancy Function**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the consultancy functions including:
   

  




* Preparation and coordination of expressions of interest, tender submissions and similar consulting proposals
* Maintain a hands\-on approach to the provision of design and engineering, and assist in the co\-ordination of other consultancy inputs in relation to BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS on an as needs basis
* Contribute and monitor the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e., structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.)

**Technical Excellence**

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.jd_text:
**About Faux Consultancy.** 




 Founded in 2011, Faux is the Middle East’s leading Public Relations and Events Consultancy, working in partnership with global brands and the region’s most exciting independent concepts. Based in Dubai and working actively across the whole of the GCC, Faux is a trusted on\-the\-ground partner for brands focused on amplifying their visibility and commercial success in the region. Faux’s client divisions focus solely on Fashion and Beauty, spanning the luxury and niche sectors. This sharp focus, along with the agency’s legacy of over a decade of innovative brand representation, allows for a level of experience and insight that is unmatched. We are committed to providing the most qualitative, thoughtful and effective representation for our brands.
 



  





 The Account Director is a central leadership role within Faux, spanning key pillars of strategic development and project implementation for both local and international clients. Working in direct collaboration with the Senior Management team, this is a position that involves engagement in both day\-to\-day Account Direction and team management, as well as high\-level strategic planning and the opportunity to be involved in Business Development.
 



  





 Overseeing a portfolio of Beauty brands, the Account Director is responsible for leading a team of employees in the successful management and representation of their ‘team portfolio’, ensuring a qualitative approach to Public Relations in the GCC, and achieving certain KPIs associated with the accounts.
 



 The Account Director ensures that best\-practice standards are always in place, from strategy development through to campaign execution, and enjoys a level of autonomy in the management of their ‘working group’ to best utilise and develop the talents of their team.
 



  





 This role requires significant industry experience in a similar Senior PR position, working specifically across Beauty clients, preferably with experience or insight into the GCC Market. The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong sense of self\-direction and a desire to take on a top leadership role within a market\-leading, fast\-paced and dynamic agency.
 



  





 Innovation, professionalism, and a qualitative approach to Public Relations lie at the heart of Faux's approach to client representation, and these qualities will be reflected in the successful candidate, in terms of their previous success and future goals.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Development and implementation of innovative and effective GCC\-wide strategies for PR clients, spanning Press, Influencer, VIP and CRM Relations
* Leadership of a dedicated team within the company, providing structure, mentorship and guidance to ensure smooth workflow and delivery
* Securing qualitative, high\-value PR coverage and other results in line with allocated KPIs, always aiming to exceed targets
* Demonstrate strong leadership skills, including allocation of tasks, mentoring of direct reports, and providing clear, critical feedback
* Responsibility for the successful delivery of organic and commercial PR projects carried out on behalf of clients, including planning, implementation, and post\-activity analysis
* Work in partnership with the Faux Events team to effectively plan and host events, activations, and other concepts for agency clients
* Provide active contribution to the business development goals of the agency, participating in the development and presentation of pitches for new business
* Maintain a strong awareness of industry trends, talents, and other movements, to provide the best possible insight to clients, GCC\-wide
* Planning and negotiation of commercial talent and media deals on behalf of clients, including advertorials, ambassadorship deals, and paid campaigns
* Local content creation: show expertise and ease in handling production and post\-production of localised campaigns, which are specifically targeted to the GCC market
* Daily budget management, including the responsible planning, spending, and tracking of client budgets
* Team management to ensure the accurate data gathering, analysis and client reporting are carried out within the provided deadlines
* Active contribution to the development of a positive workplace culture, collaborating and sharing suggestions with Senior Management on ways to best motivate and reward the team.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* A bachelor's or master’s degree in public relations, communications or other relevant discipline
* **At least 8 years of PR industry experience, including in the role of Public Relations / Communications Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **At least 3 years in a similar role or as a Senior PR Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **A strong media and influencer network across the GCC is an essential requirement**
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to confidently guide, motivate and manage a team
* A creative thinker who values innovation, bringing to the table fresh ideas and strategies
* Proven success in a previous senior PR role, including the securing of high\-value coverage and the generation of market\-leading ideas
* Excellent regional networks with the leading press, influencers, stylists and celebrities
* A positive and engaged attitude to relationship development in the region
* An awareness and understanding of regional market nuances, and their impact on Beauty brand management
* A keen interest in social media trends and a keen interest in staying ahead of the curve, always to nourish our clients with fresh concepts and locally relevant and time\-sensitive social listening ideas
* Strong multi\-tasking and organisational skills, to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment where many projects are carried out in parallel
* High level of organisation and experience in complex workflow management, with the ability to hit strict deadlines and KPIs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging stories
* Ad\-hoc regional and international travel will be required.

data.jd_text:
U\+A, a part of the Egis Group, is a leading international architectural and design firm offering a multidisciplinary approach. Our services include architecture, interior design, landscape architecture, urban planning, and master planning. With a commitment to high standards and fostering creativity, we bring a practical and meticulous approach to each project. Together with Egis, our diverse team excels in areas such as architecture, interior design, structural engineering, building services, and sustainability. Having successfully delivered prestigious projects in the middle east, we attribute our success to a nuanced understanding of local markets, cultural sensitivities, and a dedication to tailor\-made solutions for our clients.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are looking for an experienced Project Manager with a pre\-contract bias, to support our exciting growth plans, working with our key clients. The Project Manager will oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of the design projects, ensuring they meet quality standards, timelines, and budgets. The Senior Project Manager will act as a bridge between creative teams and stakeholders, managing resources, schedules, and deliverables.
   

  





 The Project Manager will be joining an established team of like\-minded experts that have a passion for innovation and growth. The Senior Project Manager will provide a comprehensive, accurate and value\-driven service for large, high\-profile and exciting key clients.
   

  





 The responsibilities include defining project timelines and activities in collaboration with stakeholders, resolving changes in scope, issues and risks that impact project implementation, assigning talent and resources to projects, and guiding and coaching staff. The role requires excellent collaborative, time management and multi\-tasking skills. This individual should also be familiar with quality assurance practices to ensure products possess maximum functionality.
   

  





 The role will cover all aspects of project management throughout the whole project lifecycle from initial inception / business case through to completion.
   

  





**Duties include** 
 (not limited to):
   

  




* Project Planning \& Execution: Defining and clarifying the project scope, setting timelines, and establishing budgets. Facilitate meetings and presentations with clients and team members. Monitor project progress and adjust plans as needed.
* Team Leadership: Managing and motivating design teams, assigning tasks, and providing guidance.
* Stakeholder Communication: Keeping stakeholders informed on project progress, managing expectations, and addressing concerns.
* Resource Management: Coordinate project schedules, resources, and budgets for design initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and stakeholder expectations.
* Quality Assurance: Overseeing the quality of design deliverables and ensuring they meet standards.
* Risk Management: Identifying potential risks and developing mitigation strategies.
* Budget Management: Tracking project expenses and ensuring adherence to budget guidelines.
* Experience of undertaking cost/commercial management as part of integrated, multi\-organization, collaborative teams is preferred.
* Implement strategies to manage and control costs throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare detailed cost forecasts and budget reports, analyzing variances and identifying trends to support financial decision\-making.
* Implement cost control measures and monitor project expenditures, addressing any issues that could lead to budget overruns.
* Facilitate communication and collaboration between design teams, marketing, product development, and external agencies to streamline workflows and resolve potential roadblocks.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables, using project management software to track progress effectively.
* Manage scope changes and potential risks throughout the design project lifecycle, implementing mitigation strategies to keep projects on track and within budget.
* Reporting: Prepare and present regular project status reports to stakeholders, highlighting key achievements, challenges, and upcoming activities.
* Conduct post\-project reviews to identify lessons learned and implement process improvements for future design initiatives and team efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in design, engineering, project management, or a related field.
* 15 years of experience in the real estate sector.
* Proven experience in project management within a design or creative environment.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in project management tools and techniques.


**Additional Information**

**Key Skills** 
 :
   

  




* Strong Project Management Skills: Ability to plan, organize, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders and teams.
* Leadership Skills: Ability to motivate and guide a team, fostering a collaborative environment.
* Problem\-Solving Skills: Ability to identify and resolve issues that may arise during a project.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with design software and project management tools.
* Understanding Design Principles: Knowledge of design fundamentals and best practices.

data.jd_text:
WW\+P is a world\-leading architecture, urban design, and planning practice with more than 400 architects, urban designers, and planners across 12 studios worldwide, including offices in London and Manchester. Founded in 1985, the practice integrates planning, urban design, landscape architecture, and architecture to deliver projects that combine visionary regenerative design thinking with technical excellence. Our work spans scales and disciplines to create better cities, smarter infrastructure, and more inclusive communities.
   

  





 WW\+P is also a member of the 10N Collective, a group of leading urbanism, architecture, and design practices brought together by Egis. In 2026, SvN Architects and Planners merged with WW\+P, bringing together more than 80 years of combined expertise in transformative urban design and planning.
   

  





 As part of the Egis Group, a global leader in architecture, consulting, engineering, construction, and mobility services, WW\+P contributes to shaping sustainable, resilient, and climate\-responsive environments worldwide. Operating in 100 countries with 19,500 employees, Egis delivers innovative solutions that support balanced territorial development and improve quality of life for communities around the globe.
   

  





 In the Middle East, Egis employs 3,500 professionals across eight countries and has successfully delivered more than 700 complex development projects. Recognised among the region's leading engineering and consulting firms, Egis combines global expertise with deep local knowledge to support governments, investors, and developers in delivering sustainable growth and lasting positive impact.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* Represent WW\+P in the region, utilising a comprehensive knowledge of the WW\+P project portfolio, values, and approach.
* Collaborate with the WW\+P global studio, primarily through liaison with the Middle East Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team.
* Collaborate with the 10N Collective to maximise working synergies and support regional growth.
* Collaborate with all relevant Egis Business Lines and Units to maximise working synergies and support growth. Close working relationships with relevant colleagues in Transportation, Energy \& Sustainable Cites, and Aviation will be important to the success of the role.
* Support the management of design teams based in the WW\+P global studios, in the role of local first\-point\-of\-contact for clients and partners.
* Build key client relationships through increased exposure and networking and establish business opportunity within this.
* Be a champion of a user\-centric design philosophy, demonstrating empathy with end\-users and creating projects that resonate with their needs and desires.
* Safeguard and evolve the identity of WW\+P, ensuring output aligns with the brand's values and messaging.
* Support and mine new business opportunities: advance the client’s knowledge of core capabilities; recognize untapped opportunities within existing relationships; leverage formal and informal networks in the pursuit of new business possibilities.
* Maximise project profit returns where possible.


**Qualifications**
* Proven track record of delivering excellent, award\-winning design on a variety of project typologies.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate and present design concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the Middle East construction market, including the relevant local and international clients, consultants, contractors and stakeholders.
* Leadership experience including the ability to communicate with and manage remote design teams.
* Strong commercial understanding and project management.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and successful implementations.

data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred
* 15 \+years of project and site experience in large scale power projects, some in CCGT projects.
* Extensive knowledge of utilities and construction of Combined Cycle Power Plants.
* Experience in large infrastructure project execution.
* Experience with Turnkey EPC contractors. (with Chinese EPC contractor preferred)
* Strong technical knowledge and understanding of construction processes, contracts, and international standards.
* Contract/claim management and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with BOO project structures, project finance documents, EPC contracts, PPAs.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead teams.
* Strong ethical standards.

**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The Regional Head, Transaction Banking (TB) Cash Client Service for Africa and Middle East \& Pakistan (MENAP) is responsible for driving client service delivery outcomes and overall team performance across the region.
   

  

 This role ensures high\-quality, consistent client service delivery across all client segments, with a differentiated experience for top\-tier clients. It oversees Straight2Bank (S2B) Solution Activation (SAT), including onboarding and maintenance processes for both new\-to\-bank and existing clients.
   

  

 The role is accountable for improving time\-to\-market, enhancing client experience, and ensuring seamless coordination across Sales, Implementation, Client Lifecycle Management (CLM), Digital Channels, Data \& Analytics (DCDA), Operations, Product and other internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and build a high\-performing client service team focused on delivering exceptional client experience.
* Drive operational efficiency, standardisation and continuous process improvement across the region.
* Monitor service performance against agreed benchmarks; define corrective actions where required.
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Ensure adequate systems, infrastructure, and process capabilities to support business needs.
* Drive consistency and synergies across markets, including implementation of the Target Operating Model (TOM).
* Enhance speed\-to\-market for S2B onboarding and maintenance while maintaining strong controls.
* Support revenue growth by improving onboarding efficiency and deepening client relationships.
* Provide oversight and escalation management for complex onboarding scenarios.


**Strategy**
* Align client service delivery with Corporate, Commercial \& Institutional Banking (CCIB) and Transaction Banking strategy.
* Drive automation across client service and Solution Activation processes to improve efficiency and scalability.


**Business**
* Identify and escalate thematic client service issues for resolution.
* Ensure optimal team capacity aligned with business needs and portfolio changes.
* Deliver process improvements that drive efficiency and support business growth.
* Lead and support regional and global initiatives for onboarding and servicing transformation.


**Processes**
* Drive effective client service operations, including issue tracking, escalation and resolution.
* Maintain client service logs and ensure proactive management of service gaps.
* Use management information systems (MIS) and service dashboards to identify trends and address root causes.
* Ensure disciplined handling of client complaints in line with Bank policy.
* Manage end\-to\-end service delivery teams with clear Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).


**Solution Activation**
* Own and manage end\-to\-end orchestration of S2B onboarding and maintenance processes.
* Ensure efficient client engagement and readiness\-to\-transact across all onboarding scenarios.
* Promote first\-time\-right delivery and process standardisation.
* Drive improvements through automation and best practice sharing.
* Oversee channel activation, documentation, setup, training and pre\-transactional support for clients.
* Ensure adherence to all internal controls, compliance requirements and regulatory standards.


**People \& Talent**
* Attract, develop and retain top client service talent.
* Drive a culture of accountability, client\-centricity and high performance.

data.jd_text:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Project Director**
**The Company**
 WPP Production is a fast growing division of WPP group. WPP Production is headquartered in London but is present in many markets around the world, working through three global hubs (Singapore, New York and London) and with customer service and production facilities in multiple countries across every continent.
   

  

 WPP Production is an expert provider of marketing communications and advertising production services across Broadcast, Print and Digital media with a full suite of services that can take a creative advertising or promotional concept and deliver it, translated and culturally adapted, in whatever the required medium into every target market in the world, with better turnaround times, higher quality, more functional technology and more effective return on production investment than any competitive offering.
   

  

 Our clients are the world’s leading brands in consumer goods, financial services, automotive and electronics and we therefore compete in markets that demand the absolute highest standards of quality, customer care, reliability and value.
   

  

 Culturally, we seek to combine the entrepreneurial enthusiasm and creativity of an agency start up with the standards and delivery of a world\-class professional services business.
   

  

 We are a culturally diverse organization in a period of transition. We currently have around 2,300 full time employees representing the results of 8 years of continuous growth since start up.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for a passionate leader and technical champion for the creation of rich front\-end experiences.
   

  

 You will manage a team of HTML5, Javascript, CSS developers and be ultimately responsible for the clients’ technical delivery.
   

  

 You have an in\-depth knowledge of current and emerging front\-end technologies and can work with server\-side technical leads to create and integrate complex client\-side applications. You will have a clear idea of what ‘good’ looks like, and be able to communicate best practice to your colleagues and fellow project members. You will work with WPP Production and partner organisations to define the optimum technical approach for client projects and ceaselessly promote best practice, quality and craft in your code and the code of those you lead.
   

  

 Strong communication skills, including the ability to listen, understand, advocate, and persuade are essential as you will represent your practice in client and internal senior stakeholder meetings.
   

  

 You will Provide technical thought leadership and promote the vision, strategy and services of the digital department to both educate our teams within Hogarth and to be seen as a leading figure in the industry.
   

  

 Define our distributed development strategy and processes across our onshore, offshore and remote teams, including identifying and developing key strategic technology partnerships.
   

  

 You will manage a team of highly skilled developers ranging from Graduate to Senior level, implementing and maintaining development practices, running meetings and workshops that ensure the growth, motivation and continued development of the team, and ultimately take responsibility for the quality of your team’s output.
   

  

 The team needs to build/modify responsive web pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc. based on the visual briefs.
   

  

 You will work closely with other discipline leads (QA/PM) to ensure scoping, estimates, and requirements are estimated correctly and delivered with minimal errors.
   

  

 You must be enthusiastic about technology and constantly be looking at the next innovation. On top of possessing strong oral, interpersonal, and organizational abilities, you must be able to work in a fast paced environment. Flexibility and tolerance is a necessity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Co\-ordinating with leads across key delivery teams (Tech, Project Management, QA, and Resource Management)
* Ensure compliance with WPP production processes
* Acting as the point of escalation for project issues raised by team leads, resolving problems quickly and communicating effectively
* Coaching and developing the team in their roles with regular performance reviews to ensure success in their personal development
* Manage the team hiring and keeping briefs clear and consistently updated
* Interviewing candidates for the team and taking responsibility for the approval of freelancers to work in a fast paced and reactive environment
* Set and manage client expectations while coordinating and ensuring all parties follow the agreed workflows
* Build strong, trusting relationships with all key stakeholders, function leads, cross\-functional project managers, senior managers, and third\-party vendors that are directly involved with the work
* Manage the approval of quarterly budgets, flagging important budget fluctuations to the client and line manager
* Draft, prepare and present timelines, documents, and presentations and reports both to the client and to the team
* Ensure that the line manager is always aware of all client issues and proposed solutions (including potential delays) to ensure swift resolution and avoid further escalation
* Ensure your account consistently delivers against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
* Act as a brand QC/Guardian – always ensure brand guidelines, QC checklists and procedures are followed
* Keep GAD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
* teamwork, create balanced work schedule and ensure people are able to deliver results
* Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow
* Plan resources for overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs
* Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters


**Requirements**
* A minimum of 10 years Project Management experience background
* Experience of leading innovation, leveraging emerging platforms and quickly facilitating new ideas and platforms to market
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills
* Know\-how in working cross\-functionally to build relationships between business units, technology, product, media, agency, and design teams
* Experience working on international initiatives \- ideally with exposure to emerging markets
* Self\-motivated and a self\-starter
* Very high competence in project management software such as Microsoft Project and Omniplan
* Extensive experience in costing, quotations and project scope definition


* Excellent communication skills to different target groups within the project team, management and clients
* Ensure understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant
* Analytical and detailed in project documentation, accountability, and tracking
* Pragmatic, team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Understanding of brands and brand challenges
* The ability to function productively in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment
* High level of IT literacy, including use of spreadsheets
* Strong numeracy skills
* Support GAD/CSD and FD in revenue forecasting on an ongoing basis
* Keep GAD/CSD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
* Ensure full compliance with all financial procedure and policies
* Prioritization, time management and attention to detail
* Resilience and ability to work under pressure
* Excellent communication skills, written and verbal, in both Arabic and English
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Highly organised, detail oriented, customer focused, and proactive
* Possess technical understanding of mobile and web technologies necessary to run projects and convey details. Examples would be:
+ iOS and Android development
+ Cloud computing
+ HTML5/CSS/JavaScript
+ ecommerce/Shopping Carts
+ Social Media Strategies/Platforms

* Familiarity with creative production and development tools is always an advantage. Such software includes Adobe Creative Suite, BBEdit, SVN, GitHub, Eclipse, Dreamweaver, Final Cut Pro and others. In addition, familiarity with mobile and web platforms and ecosystems would also be advantageous
* Must be able to travel as required, sometimes for several weeks at a time


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
   

  

**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
Executive Assistant — Middle East
 **(Maternity Cover)**




  





***About the Role***




 This is an exciting opportunity to join a
 **top\-tier international law firm** 
 in a key role within its Middle East team. The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East, bringing substantial EA experience gained within an international law firm based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
 



  





 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
 



  





***Roles and Responsibilities***




  





**Executive Support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Proactively manage the Head's complex, high\-volume diary, scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones and senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Act as gatekeeper, triaging meeting requests, queries and issues, and redirecting them appropriately while ensuring matters are resolved effectively.
* Prepare agendas, attend meetings the Head is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and follow up with action owners to ensure timely completion.
* Attend meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head where appropriate, independently managing follow\-up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
* Prepare briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to support strategic and commercial decision\-making.
* Anticipate information needs and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams ahead of key meetings or decisions.



  





**Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation** 



* Arrange end\-to\-end complex travel, including multi\-destination international itineraries, transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
* Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction\-specific requirements.
* Provide strategic input into travel planning, combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
* Liaise with colleagues across offices and functions to ensure a joined\-up, firm\-wide approach that maximises the value of each trip.
* Manage last\-minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently.
* Prepare detailed post\-trip reports covering meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities and next steps, and ensure all follow\-up actions are diarised and progressed.



  





**Marketing \& Business Development Support** 



* Manage speaking engagements and thought\-leadership commitments, tracking deadlines, coordinating research, and drafting materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
* Arrange briefing meetings ahead of panels, speaking slots or publications to ensure the Head is fully prepared.
* Liaise with the Knowledge team and internal stakeholders to obtain research and background material, ensuring contributions are accurate and high quality.
* Register the Head for events and prepare comprehensive pre\-event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives.
* Work with the Head and Business Development teams to maintain up\-to\-date client target lists, tracking status and ensuring assigned actions are progressed.
* Provide regular status updates on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against objectives.



  





**Billing, Finance \& Expenses** 



* Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head's matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
* Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance, and issue final invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
* Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head.
* Oversee expense submissions, liaising directly with vendors to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where needed.
* Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget\-holder approval in line with firm policy.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding invoices and payments, keeping the Head and the Billing and Finance teams fully informed.



  





**Performance \& People Processes** 



* Support the Head throughout the performance review process, scheduling review meetings in line with firm\-wide deadlines.
* Prepare review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
* Monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
* Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head during discussions.
* Support completion of post\-meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, and maintain oversight of outstanding actions.
* Maintain close, regular communication with HR throughout the review cycle, confirming deadlines and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.



  





**CRM \& Relationship Management** 



* Maintain and update the Head's contacts and relationship data in InterAction, accurately recording activities, meetings and notes.
* Support the Head in managing effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers across jurisdictions.
* Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring they are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
* Ensure referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow\-up on agreed actions and opportunities.



  





**Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison** 



* Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and updating the Head regularly.
* Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations) to ensure strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of regional initiatives.
* Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings to keep all functions informed, aligned and engaged, agreeing deliverables and capturing activities, deadline changes and requirements for the Head's radar.
* Ensure key outputs feed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings.



  





**Person Specification** 



* Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or in a similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi\-time\-zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
* Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi\-destination itineraries, visas and short\-notice changes.
* Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparing draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
* Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
* Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
* Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to draft correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
* Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
* Professional, client\-focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior stakeholders and clients.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

data.jd_text:
We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost\-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build, acquire, lease\-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are the major Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) and we serve them across nine high\-growth markets (8 in Africa and Oman in the Middle East). Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.
   

  

**Overview**
 Reporting to the Group Director of SOC \& Systems (or relevant Group Operations leader), you will play a pivotal role in leading the transformation of a distributed, multi\-market NOC environment into a digitally enabled Smart Operating Centre.
   

  

 This is a Group\-level transformation leadership role responsible for embedding governance discipline, strengthening cross\-market accountability, integrating core operational systems, and delivering measurable improvements in uptime, energy efficiency, SLA compliance and operational performance across nine markets.
   

  

**Location** 
 : Dubai
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
 As the Group SOC \& Systems Senior Manager, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading the transformation and standardisation of multi\-OpCo NOC operations into a unified Smart Operating Centre model
* Embedding structured governance frameworks, escalation discipline and audit trail compliance across all markets
* Driving integration across RMS, ServiceNow, ERP, ICCP and workforce management platforms to create a single operational view
* Strengthening incident management processes, improving MTTR and ensuring SLA\-driven operational excellence
* Enhancing real\-time telemetry utilisation, alarm\-to\-action automation and predictive analytics capabilities
* Managing and influencing cross\-market stakeholders and third\-party field service partners without direct line authority
* Improving uptime engineering, energy optimisation and fuel governance across site portfolios
* Establishing clear accountability frameworks, KPIs and operational value metrics (e.g. truck roll reduction, SLA penalty avoidance, fuel efficiency)
* Translating technical operational issues into financial and business impact for executive stakeholders


**Requirements For The Role**
 To succeed in this role, you will have:
   

  

* At least 10 years’ experience in infrastructure or mission\-critical operations, including NOC, SOC or control centre environments
* Demonstrable experience leading multi\-country or multi\-site operational environments
* Strong expertise in real\-time telemetry, alarm environments, incident management and SLA\-driven operations
* Experience integrating or optimising platforms such as RMS, ServiceNow, ERP, ICCP or workforce management systems
* Proven ability to embed governance discipline, structured escalation frameworks and operational accountability across complex organisations
* Experience managing outsourced field service ecosystems and third\-party partners
* Strong stakeholder management capability, with experience influencing senior leaders across multiple markets
* A structured, resilient and assertive leadership style, comfortable challenging underperformance where required
* Experience operating in emerging markets environments
* Knowledge of telecommunications, tower infrastructure, energy systems or hybrid power environments is highly advantageous.

* Operational Governance \& Compliance

* Predictive Analytics \& Automation Enablement
* Business Performance Management
* Knowledge of French language (advantageous)


**Benefits**
* Competitive basic salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
