**Position Description \& Qualifications**
 Are you a Systems Administrator looking for a place to make an impact every day? Serco is the place for you! Join our team as a Senior Systems Administrator in support of our Anti\-Terrorism Force\-Protection (AT/FP) program with the United States Navy.
   

  

 The AT/FP Ashore Sustainment Program is executed by the CNIC PSS AT/FP Ashore Program Management Office (PMO), NAVFAC Expeditionary Warfare Center (EXWC), and CNIC Regional Program Managers (RPMs). The primary goal of the CNIC AT/FP Ashore Sustainment Program is to provide both preventive and corrective maintenance services to Navy installations as required to sustain AT/FP Ashore Program systems in accordance with their operational requirements. This position is based in the Bahrain and will require 25% travel or more. Additional supported sites within the region include Isa Air Base and Djibouti.
   

  

 As the AT/FP GSC Systems Administrator III for Bahrain, you will support the Commander Navy Installations Command (CNIC) Public Safety Systems (PSS) Ashore Programs and their mission is to design, procure, integrate, install, and sustain the systems/equipment hardware, associated firmware, and software required to provide the ability to protect mission\-critical assets and personnel from natural disasters, acts of terrorism and other human\-caused disasters.

* Basic clinical knowledge (vital signs, infection control, hygiene).

* **Language:** 
 Proficiency in English is required; Arabic knowledge is an advantage.

 The portfolio spans Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange Online/Hybrid, Microsoft Teams and SBC voice, SharePoint/OneDrive, Microsoft Defender, Intune endpoint fleet, certificates, DNS, enterprise AI platforms (Claude \+ Microsoft Copilot), and a large SSO/application integration portfolio.
 



  
 


**Your Responsibilities**
**Identity \& Access Management**
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID and on\-premises AD across all environments
* Design and maintain Conditional Access, PIM, RBAC, MFA, and SSO (OAuth, OIDC, SAML)
* Own hybrid identity via Entra Connect


**Messaging \& Email**
* Administer Exchange Online and Exchange Server (hybrid), including DAG, mail flow, and transport rules
* Own email security (gateway, DMARC, DKIM, SPF) and manage mailbox migrations


**Collaboration \& Voice**
* Administer Microsoft Teams policies, governance, and SBC\-based enterprise voice (dial plans, call queues, PSTN)
* Manage SharePoint Online and OneDrive, including external sharing and Known Folder Move


**Security \& Threat Protection**
* Operate Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and Endpoint (EDR, ASR, security baselines)
* Lead incident response and maintain hardening controls aligned to CIS benchmarks


**Endpoint Management (Intune)**
* Manage a mid\-to\-large multi\-country fleet (Windows, macOS, Android, iOS)
* Own Autopilot, compliance/configuration policies, update rings, app packaging, and PowerShell remediation scripts


**Certificates, DNS \& Web Publishing**
* Manage full SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and DNS/CDN/WAF/DDoS platforms
* Own domain governance, registrations, and the web publishing approval workflow


**Artificial Intelligence**
* Administer enterprise AI platforms including Claude integrations and Microsoft Copilot
* Design AI workflows and agents, govern AI access, model organizational data, and manage AI licensing


**Architecture, Governance \& Leadership**
* Act as technical design authority; maintain standards, runbooks, and documentation

الهدف العام للوظيفة
 



 قيادة وتطوير استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة، وتحمّل المسؤولية المؤسسية عن تحقيق القيمة المضافة من خلال توظيف أصول بيانات الوزارة ومنظومة الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، وتحقيق الربط الفعّال بين التوجهات الاستراتيجية للوزارة وتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لقيادة مسيرة تبنّيه في مختلف قطاعاتها، وضمان توافق جميع المبادرات مع المعايير الأخلاقية ومتطلبات الحوكمة بما يعزز كفاءة اتخاذ القرار ويحقق أهداف التحول الذكي.
 



  





 المسؤوليات الرئيسية
 


* إعداد وقيادة استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي للوزارة بما يتوافق مع أهدافها المؤسسية والوطنية، وتطوير نموذج التشغيل اللازم لتنفيذها وقياس أثرها في تحسين الكفاءة واتخاذ القرار.
* قيادة مبادرات التحول الذكي في الوزارة بما فيها تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، واستثمار أصول البيانات المؤسسية لتحقيق قيمة مضافة قابلة للقياس.
* ضمان قابلية توسع نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وتكاملها مع سير العمل والأنظمة المؤسسية القائمة، مع ضمان جاهزية البيانات لمتطلبات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
* إنشاء وإدارة أطر حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة بما يشمل السياسات والمعايير ونماذج التشغيل، لضمان الاستخدام الأخلاقي والمسؤول وفق المعايير المحلية والدولية.
* تصميم وتطبيق إطار إدارة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تصنيف المخاطر وآليات التخفيف والمراقبة المستمرة لحماية الوزارة من الآثار السلبية المحتملة.
* الإشراف على تقييم واعتماد حالات استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان امتثالها لمتطلبات الخصوصية وحماية البيانات والاشتراطات التنظيمية المعتمدة.
* التنسيق مع قيادات الوحدات والإدارات لتعزيز القدرات الذكية عبر الوزارة، وبناء ثقافة مؤسسية تثق في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتوظّفه بصورة فعّالة.
* التعاون مع الفرق التقنية لضمان أن البنية التحتية وعمليات تقنية المعلومات وهندسة البرمجيات وإدارة البيانات تدعم تشغيل حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي واستدامتها.
* متابعة أداء وأثر مبادرات الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان تحقيق القيمة وفق مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية المعتمدة، وإعداد التقارير الدورية لقيادة الوزارة.
* تصميم وتنفيذ برامج التثقيف في الذكاء الاصطناعي وبناء القدرات التقنية لدى منسوبي الوزارة بما يضمن قدرتهم على التعامل مع أدواته وتطبيقاته بفاعلية.
* التواصل مع الجهات التنظيمية والشركاء الخارجيين والهيئات المعنية في شأن حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي واستراتيجيته.
* الإسهام في إعداد الخطط التشغيلية السنوية للقسم ومتابعة تنفيذها وضمان توافقها مع أولويات الوزارة الاستراتيجية.
* تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى يكلف بها مدير الإدارة في نطاق اختصاصه.



  





 المؤهلات والخبرة
 


* دكتوراه \- إحصاء / رياضيات تطبيقية / اقتصاد / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (بدون خبرة)
* ماجستير \- الذكاء الاصطناعي / علوم البيانات / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (3 سنوات)
* بكالوريوس \- علوم الحاسب / هندسة الحاسوب / هندسة البرمجيات / نظم المعلومات أو ما يعادلها (7 سنوات)



  





 الشهادات المهنية
 


* شهادة مهنية معتمدة في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة مثل Google Professional ML Engineer / AWS ML Specialty / Azure AI Engineer Associate
* شهادة في الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي ونماذج اللغة الكبيرة مثل LLMs DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization
* شهادة في حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي وأخلاقياته مثل IAPP AI Governance Professional / ISO 42001 Lead Implementer
* شهادة في علم البيانات وتحليل البيانات المتقدمة مثل IBM Data Science Professional / Databricks ML Associate
* شهادة في تشغيل نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وعملياته مثل MLflow MLOps Certified / Kubeflow Practitioner
* شهادة في إدارة المشاريع والتحول الرقمي أو ما يعادله ا PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe
* شهادة في إدارة البيانات وهندستها أو ما يعادلها (CDMP)
* دورة في استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي وتطبيقاته في القطاع الحكومي
* دورة في أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي والاستخدام المسؤول ومعالجة التحيز والشفافية
* دورة في قيادة التغيير وإدارة التحول المؤسسي باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي
* دورة في هندسة الطلبات وتطبيقات النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة (Prompt Engineering)



  





  





  





  





  





**Job Purpose** 




 Lead and develop the Ministry's Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy and assume enterprise\-wide responsibility for delivering measurable value through the effective utilization of the Ministry's data assets and AI ecosystem, including Generative AI applications. The role ensures the alignment of AI technologies with the Ministry's strategic objectives, drives AI adoption across all sectors, and ensures that all AI initiatives comply with ethical standards and governance requirements, thereby enhancing decision\-making efficiency and achieving the Ministry's smart transformation goals.
 



**Key Responsibilities**

* Liaise with regulatory authorities, external partners, and relevant organizations on AI governance, strategy, and compliance matters.
* Contribute to the preparation of the department's annual operational plans, monitor their implementation, and ensure alignment with the Ministry's strategic priorities.

 **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** 
 who can define our long\-term technology vision, elevate engineering excellence, and build the scalable, secure, and innovative platform that will power our future growth.
   

  





 This is a unique opportunity for an executive who thrives in high\-growth SaaS environments, enjoys building and scaling international engineering organizations, and is excited to modernize technology, accelerate innovation, and build a platform that will support the next stage of Sana Commerce's global growth. You will play a key role in driving our technology modernization journey, evolving our platform architecture, accelerating cloud transformation, and embedding AI into our engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.
   

  





**Your Mission**




 As CTO, you will define and execute Sana Commerce's long\-term Technology strategy. You will ensure our engineering organization, technology investments, and platform capabilities enable our product vision while delivering a reliable, scalable, secure, and high\-performing SaaS platform.
   

  





 Working closely with the CEO, Executive Team, and Product leadership, you will lead our global Engineering and IT organizations while fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, collaboration, and operational excellence.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**What You'll Do**




**Define the Technology Vision \& Strategy**



* Define and own Sana Commerce's long\-term Technology vision, ensuring our platform supports the company's growth ambitions and positions us as the leading B2B eCommerce platform.
* Build a technology roadmap that balances innovation, platform scalability, operational excellence, security, and long\-term sustainability.
* Inspire the organization with a clear technology vision and ensure engineering strategy supports business and product objectives.
* Define a long\-term technology strategy that supports the continued evolution of our platform from a modern SaaS application into a highly scalable, cloud\-native architecture.
* Partner closely with Product leadership to ensure technology investments support both immediate customer value and long\-term platform evolution.



**Elevate Engineering \& Technology Performance**



* Provide strategic leadership to the global Engineering and IT organizations.
* Ensure engineering execution is reliable, scalable, predictable, and aligned with business and product priorities.
* Champion technical excellence through modern software development practices, architectural discipline, cloud transformation, security, and platform modernization.
* Leverage AI and automation to improve software development, testing, quality assurance, and overall engineering effectiveness.
* Reduce technical complexity through Eliminate, Standardize, and Automate principles while continuously improving engineering efficiency.



**Deliver a World\-Class Platform**



* Own the overall health and technical lifecycle of our SaaS platform, including performance, reliability, quality, security, scalability, and resilience.
* Drive platform improvements that increase developer productivity, engineering velocity, software quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure strong cross\-functional alignment on release planning, technical priorities, resource allocation, and execution.
* Build a technology organization capable of supporting long\-term global growth.



**Drive Innovation**



* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies that strengthen Sana Commerce's competitive position.
* Lead the adoption of AI, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve both product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Create an environment where innovation is encouraged while maintaining operational excellence and platform stability.



**Build \& Lead High\-Performing Engineering Teams**



* Develop and strengthen the global Engineering leadership team.
* Build our Engineering hub in Egypt as a strategic redundancy to our engineering organization in Ukraine.
* Build succession depth, leadership capability, and attract exceptional engineering talent.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement across Engineering and Technology.


**Qualifications**

**Who You Are**




 You are a visionary technology leader who combines strategic thinking with operational excellence and knows how to scale engineering organizations in fast\-growing SaaS businesses.
   

  





 You bring:
   

  




* 10\+ years of senior technology leadership experience, including experience leading large Engineering organizations in fast\-growing SaaS businesses, ideally within B2B Software or eCommerce.
* Experience scaling globally distributed Engineering organizations across multiple countries and cultures, including offshore engineering teams.
* Deep expertise in cloud architecture, software engineering, platform modernization, distributed systems, engineering execution, and SaaS technology.
* Experience leading large international engineering organizations through periods of rapid growth and organizational transformation.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience balancing technology investments, engineering efficiency, platform costs, and business outcomes.
* Demonstrated success building high\-performing engineering cultures and developing senior technology leaders.
* A data\-driven mindset combined with strong strategic judgement.
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills.



 A hands\-on, results\-oriented leadership style—you create momentum, remove obstacles, and enable teams to succeed.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**Why This Role Matters**



* As Chief Technology Officer, you will shape the technology foundation that powers Sana Commerce's future.
* You will lead one of the company's most critical functions, define our long\-term technology strategy, build a world\-class engineering organization, and ensure our platform continues to scale securely and reliably as we grow globally.
* As a member of the Executive Team, you will influence the long\-term direction of the business while building the technology capabilities that will enable Sana Commerce to achieve its ambition of becoming the market leader by 2028\.
* Your leadership will directly determine how effectively we innovate, scale, and deliver technology that creates lasting value for our customers.

**About Rateb** 




 Rateb is a digital wallet built to make everyday payments simple, secure, and transparent in Kuwait. Employers and payers send salaries, advances, and dues digitally; recipients receive, manage, withdraw, and transfer their money with ease — replacing cash and paper receipts with secure digital records.
 



 We're launching with domestic workers and their employers — a community of hundreds of thousands that today runs almost entirely on cash. It's a focused first market, not the limit of the ambition: the same wallet, payments, and partner infrastructure are built to extend to a far wider set of users and payment needs across Kuwait.
 



  





 Designed for Kuwait's diverse population — with multi\-language support built into the product roadmap — Rateb integrates with exchange companies for transfers and banking channels for cash withdrawal.
 



  





**The Role — Head of Marketing** 




 You will own how Rateb goes to market — building the brand from launch and driving the acquisition of both employers and the workers they pay. This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Kuwait City, working closely with product, operations, and leadership to turn a new platform into a recognised, trusted name.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Own the go\-to\-market strategy and lead Rateb's launch into its first market
* Build the brand and positioning from the ground up, across two distinct audiences — employers and beneficiaries
* Plan and run multi\-channel acquisition campaigns, owning the budget and the targets
* Define the metrics that matter — cost per acquisition, activation, retention — and manage performance against them
* Manage agency and partner relationships, and brief external creative and media support
* Develop messaging that works across Kuwait's diverse, multi\-language population
* Work with product and operations to align the customer journey from first touch to active use
* Report marketing performance and spend to senior leadership



**What you'll bring** 



* Proven marketing leadership, ideally in fintech, payments, telco, or consumer services
* A track record taking a product to market — launch experience, not just steady\-state brand management
* Strong command of performance marketing and the economics behind it: CAC, funnel, retention
* Experience marketing to underserved or hard\-to\-reach audiences a real plus
* Familiarity with Kuwait's market and media landscape
* Fluency in English and Arabic

A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. We are hiring an IT Operations Officer to own the corporate IT environment: end\-user devices, productivity systems, identity management, IT support, and corporate cybersecurity hygiene.

 **.**

* Procurement, configuration, and lifecycle management of laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices; maintaining the device inventory and asset register

* Applying cybersecurity policy to corporate systems: email security, endpoint protection, patching, and security awareness training
* Managing corporate IT vendor relationships, service contracts, and the IT contract register



  





  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least five years in an IT operations, IT administration, or end\-user computing role. Demonstrated experience administering M365 or equivalent productivity suites. Working knowledge of identity management, MDM, and endpoint security. Fluent in English; working Arabic preferred. Microsoft, CompTIA, or equivalent certifications are an advantage. So is familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001\) and prior experience in a small\-firm or regulated environment.
 



  





**What this is** 




 This is a founding\-team role. The corporate IT environment is being built now, and the person in this role will set it up properly from the start. If you are self\-sufficient, security\-conscious, and want to own your environment rather than operate within one someone else built, this is worth a conversation.

Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





**About Shifamed** 




 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
 



  





 Description:
 



  





 Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and integration of advanced medical imaging systems. In this role, you will serve as a technical leader, applying your expertise to solve complex engineering problems while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams. You will play a critical role in developing innovative imaging technologies that meet regulatory standards and advance patient care. This is a full\-time, on\-site position at our new, R\&D facility in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





 Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:
 


* Contribute to the architecture, design, and integration of medical image processing systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, ISO 13485\).
* Develop and implement imaging algorithms, visualization tools, and system components.
* Collaborate closely with R\&D, clinical, regulatory, and manufacturing teams to align technical deliverables with program objectives.
* Perform feasibility studies, risk assessments, and trade\-off analyses to guide design decisions.
* Mentor junior engineers, sharing best practices in design, coding, and testing.
* Partner with external vendors and collaborators to support imaging\-related initiatives.
* Develop and execute testing protocols, verification, and validation processes.
* Contribute to technical documentation, including regulatory submissions.
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in medical imaging, proposing improvements and new approaches.



  





 Education \& Work Experience:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (M.S. preferred).
* 15\+ years of experience in medical imaging systems design and development.
* Strong knowledge of imaging modalities (e.g., X\-ray, MRI, ultrasound) and image processing algorithms.
* Proficiency in software development (e.g., MATLAB, Python, C\+\+), visualization, and hardware integration.
* Experience with UI frameworks such as VTK and Qt/QML.
* Experience with cloud\-based imaging applications and integration of AI/ML methods for computer vision/medical imaging.
* Solid understanding of regulatory and quality standards, including cybersecurity (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 60601, FDA requirements).
* Track record of technical contributions, including patents, publications, or conference presentations in medical imaging.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to succeed in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.



  





 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
 



  





 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for an Agent Tools Strategy \& Operations Specialist to own the tooling and processes that power our support agents — and to make every agent faster, more accurate, and more effective.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of operations and product. You will define what our agent tools need to do, streamline the processes agents follow, and partner with Product and Engineering to build and improve the systems that make seamless, semi\-automated support possible. You will ultimately move the classic support metrics — handle time, first contact resolution, and quality — but through a process and tooling lens, not through direct management of the agent team.
   

  

 This is a strategic, data\-driven position. We are looking for a brilliant generalist who can deeply own the agent\-experience problem space today while evolving into broader CX strategic initiatives as the organization grows.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
**Own the Agent Tooling \& Process Problem End\-to\-End**
* Understand, at an operations level, what agents need from their tools — and translate that into clear functional requirements and roadmaps.
* Map and streamline the end\-to\-end processes agents follow, removing friction, manual steps, and rework.
* Own the strategy and operations of core tooling capabilities such as case management and routing, agent assignment and capacity management, customer identification, and consolidation of fragmented tools into a unified workflow.
* Identify where semi\-automation, templating, and guided workflows can reduce effort and error.


**Partner with Product \& Engineering to Build the Tools**
* Define product feature requirements and roadmaps together with Product and Engineering.
* Develop project plans across stakeholder groups to ensure successful development and deployment of features.
* Act as the quality\-assurance arm of development — flag critical quality blockers and risks ahead of feature launches.
* Drive continuous improvement post\-launch through defect tracking and remediation.


**Drive Support Operations Metrics Through Tooling**
* Move the core support metrics — average handle time (AHT), first contact resolution (FCR), resolution time, and quality — by improving processes and tools rather than managing people.
* Build reporting and diagnostics that connect tooling and process changes to metric movement.
* Design experiments and pilots to validate that a tooling or process change actually improves agent efficiency and customer outcomes before scaling it.


**Use Data to Drive Decisions**
* Leverage SQL, dashboards, and analytics tools to uncover where agents lose time and where processes break down.
* Quantify the impact of tooling gaps and prioritize the highest\-leverage improvements.
* Build frameworks to monitor agent efficiency KPIs and early\-warning signals.


**Contribute as a CX Generalist**

 A core responsibility is to implement the right technology stack, AI tools, and automated dashboards to monitor portfolio KPIs and provide leadership with real\-time insights.

* Track venture progress from selection through proof of concept, implementation, fundraising, and spin\-off.

-

* Develop portfolio governance frameworks and standardized performance metrics.

* Strong collaboration is established between startups, Rubix partners, and ecosystem stakeholders.



  





**Profile** 




 You are a proactive operator who enjoys working with founders, thrives in fast\-paced environments, and are passionate about helping innovative ventures succeed.
